James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

United Airlines has added two new transcontinental routes from San Francisco International Airport (SFO). It'll operate from its Pacific hub to both Norfolk and Richmond, both of which are in Virginia.

Last month, the carrier disclosed two transcon routes from SFO to Charleston, South Carolina, and Hartford, Connecticut . While Charleston, Norfolk, and Richmond have not previously had United flights from SFO, Hartford has, most recently in 2018 .
United From San Francisco to Norfolk & Richmond

While United will serve both long domestic routes next year, only two weekly flights will exist on both of them, all on the 166-seat Boeing 737 MAX 8. This configuration has 16 domestic first seats, along with 54 seats in economy plus and 96 seats in main cabin. The schedule, more or less the same for both routes, will allow connectivity to/from various Asia-Pacific destinations. Manila, Seoul, and Tokyo will be especially important.

The Star Alliance member will be the sole operator between SFO and ORF. Cirium Diio shows that it is a brand-new market, with no nonstop services with any airline in the past. It is, therefore, historical in nature. With 43,400 round-trip local passengers, ORF was SFO's tenth-largest unserved domestic market .

SFO to RIC is very different. United will coexist with Breeze Airways, which commenced the long route in May 2022. Running twice-weekly on the Airbus A220-200, it will be the first time the airport pair has had two carriers operating nonstop. Fortunately, both airlines will operate on different days of the week. While United will focus on the local market and some connectivity via SFO, virtually all of Breeze's traffic is point-to-point. With 70,000 local passengers , it was SFO's fifth-largest domestic market that did not have United flights.
United Now Has Seven Routes From SFO Starting In 2027

While the list of upcoming routes in 2027 will almost certainly increase, the latest information, as of November 2, shows that the following routes will launch. They'll all take off at the end of March, as northern carriers, including United, will switch to summer schedules based on IATA slot seasons on Sunday, March 28, 2027.

The additions join four markets that materialized in 2026 or will do so in the remainder of the year. The first to launch was SFO to Carlsbad, California, on March 29, with two daily services on SkyWest E175s. Flights to Portland International Jetport Airport (PWM), Maine, followed on June 27, with a weekly 737 MAX 8 operation. Both airport pairs are brand-new, which is always great to see. PWM is the longest nonstop domestic service from SFO.

詹姆斯与路线开发息息相关。詹姆斯曾就读于拉夫堡大学和克兰菲尔德大学航空运输管理专业，拥有航空公司战略和经济学博士学位。 James 曾任伦敦卢顿机场市场机会分析师和 anna.aero 首席分析师。他向本科生和研究生教授航空公司战略和经济学五年，并与多家航空公司在航线和市场情报项目上密切合作。他居住在英国伦敦附近。
美国联合航空新增了两条从旧金山国际机场 (SFO) 出发的跨大陆航线。它将从其太平洋枢纽运营至诺福克和里士满，这两个城市都位于弗吉尼亚州。
上个月，该航空公司披露了两条从 SFO 飞往南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿和康涅狄格州哈特福德的运输航线。虽然查尔斯顿、诺福克和里士满之前没有从 SFO 出发的美联航航班，但哈特福德最近一次是在 2018 年开通的。
联合航空 从 旧金山 飞往 诺福克和里士满
虽然美联航明年将提供这两条长途国内航线，但这两条航线每周仅执飞两趟航班，且全部由 166 座的波音 737 MAX 8 飞机提供。这种配置有 16 个国内头等舱座位，以及 54 个豪华经济舱座位和 96 个主舱座位。两条航线的时刻表大致相同，将允许往返亚太地区各个目的地。马尼拉、首尔和东京尤其重要。
星空联盟成员将成为 SFO 和 ORF 之间的唯一运营商。 Cirium Diio表明这是一个全新的市场，过去没有任何航空公司提供直达服务。因此，它本质上是历史性的。 ORF 拥有 43,400 名往返当地乘客，是 SFO 第十大未提供服务的国内市场。

SFO 到 RIC 有很大不同。美联航将与微风航空 (Breeze Airways) 共存，微风航空于 2022 年 5 月开始运营这条长途航线。每周使用空客 A220-200 执飞两班，这将是这两个机场首次同时拥有两家航空公司直飞运营。幸运的是，两家航空公司将在一周的不同日子运营。虽然美联航将重点关注本地市场以及通过 SFO 进行的部分连接，但几乎所有 Breeze 的流量都是点对点的。 SFO 拥有 7 万名当地乘客，是没有美联航航班的第五大国内市场。
从 2027 年开始，美联航现已开通 7 条从 SFO 出发的航线
虽然 2027 年即将开通的航线列表几乎肯定会增加，但截至 11 月 2 日的最新信息显示，将开通以下航线。它们都将于 3 月底起飞，因为包括联合航空在内的北方航空公司将在 2027 年 3 月 28 日（星期日）根据 IATA 航班时刻切换到夏季航班时刻表。
这些新增市场将在 2026 年实现或在今年剩余时间实现，这四个市场将随之实现。第一个航班是 3 月 29 日从 SFO 飞往加利福尼亚州卡尔斯巴德，由 SkyWest E175 提供每日两班航班。随后，737 MAX 8 于 6 月 27 日运营每周飞往缅因州波特兰国际喷射机机场 (PWM) 的航班。两个机场都是全新的，总是很值得一看。 PWM 是从 SFO 出发的最长的直达国内航班。

Luke has over a decade of experience as a travel writer and aviation analyst. As a passionate traveler based across the Middle East and Asia, Luke offers strong insights into the industry. Based in South East Asia.

Air Canada is preparing to use its Boeing 787 Dreamliners on 11 routes from November 2026. Along with new destinations, the Canadian carrier will deploy the 787 on returning services and on routes currently served by other aircraft types.

Three cities will join the airline's network for the first time, namely Guangzhou (CAN), Sapporo (CTS) and Dubrovnik (DBV), while nonstop flights to Quito (UIO) will return from both Toronto and Montreal. Six routes will receive Dreamliner service during the 2026/27 winter season, with the remaining five changes to follow in May and June 2027.
Air Canada's Boeing 787 Routes From November 2026

Air Canada will operate the 787 from all three of its main hubs: Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ), Montréal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL) and Vancouver International Airport (YVR). Its first change will be a temporary one, scheduling a handful of Boeing 787-8 flights between Toronto and Phoenix (PHX) for November only. The Dreamliner has served the route before, with the airline operating a daily 787-9 during the 2023/24 winter season.

December will then bring five additional 787 routes. From December 1, the airline's daily service between Vancouver and Cancun (CUN) will switch from the Boeing 737 MAX 8 to the 787-9, while Montreal–Quito and Toronto–Quito return with 787-8s on December 4 and 5, respectively.

Toronto–Barcelona (BCN), normally a summer route, was initially scheduled to receive three weekly 787-8 flights between December 16 and January 9. However, this will rise to up to a daily flight over the holiday period, using both the 787-8 and 787-9. Vancouver–Sapporo then launches on December 17 with three weekly Boeing 787-9 services.

The remaining five changes will take place during summer 2027. Vancouver–Guangzhou launches on May 4, followed by Montreal–Dubrovnik on May 11, with both routes operating three times weekly. Montreal–Tel Aviv (TLV) will also return with three weekly 787-9 flights in May. Toronto–Prague (PRG) and Toronto–Stockholm (ARN) will switch to the 787-9 in May and June, respectively.
New Destinations In Asia, Europe & South America

At 6,340 miles (10,203 km), Vancouver–Guangzhou is the longest of the 11 routes and will become Air Canada's third destination in mainland China, joining Beijing and Shanghai. The carrier will become the only North American airline serving Guangzhou, although it will face competition from China Southern Airlines, which already flies between Guangzhou and Vancouver.

When announcing Vancouver–Sapporo, Air Canada said it would be the only nonstop connection between North America and Hokkaido. However, United Airlines has since announced it will launch a three-times-weekly 787-9 service from San Francisco on December 11, six days before Air Canada's first flight. Air Canada originally planned to use the 787-8, but its latest schedule update now shows the 787-9 operating every flight.

Dubrovnik will mark Air Canada's return to Croatia for the first time since summer 2019. The seasonal service will run until October 24, using the smaller 787-8. Meanwhile, Quito will rejoin Air Canada's network for the first time since March 2020.

The airline previously operated seasonal flights from Toronto using Air Canada Rouge Boeing 767-300s, but suspended the service at the start of the pandemic. It will become the only airline offering nonstop flights between Canada and Ecuador, flying from both Montreal and Toronto until March 2027.
What Passengers Can Expect Onboard Air Canada's Boeing 787s

Air Canada's Boeing 787-8 and 787-9 both offer three cabin classes, with Signature Class (business class), Premium Economy and Economy. The 787-8 has 20 Signature Class seats, 21 Premium Economy seats and 214 Economy seats, while the larger 787-9 increases capacity to 30 Signature Class, 21 Premium Economy and 247 Economy seats.

Signature Class features lie-flat business class seats in a 1-2-1 layout, giving every passenger direct aisle access. Premium Economy is set up in a 2-3-2 layout, while Economy is arranged in a 3-3-3 configuration. Air Canada currently operates 40 Boeing 787s , comprising eight 787-8s and 32 787-9s. It also has 14 Boeing 787-10s on order, with the first expected to arrive around the end of 2026.

卢克拥有十多年的旅行作家和航空分析师经验。作为一名遍及中东和亚洲的热情旅行者，卢克对该行业提供了深刻的见解。总部位于东南亚。
加拿大航空准备从 2026 年 11 月起在 11 条航线上使用波音 787 梦想飞机。除了新的目的地之外，加拿大航空公司还将在返程航班和目前由其他机型运营的航线上部署 787 飞机。
三个城市将首次加入该航空公司的网络，即广州 (CAN)、札幌 (CTS) 和杜布罗夫尼克 (DBV)，而飞往基多 (UIO) 的直飞航班将从多伦多和蒙特利尔返回。 6 条航线将在 2026/27 年冬季开通梦想飞机服务，其余 5 条航线将于 2027 年 5 月和 6 月进行调整。
加拿大航空 2026 年 11 月起的波音 787 航线
加拿大航空将从其所有三个主要枢纽运营 787：多伦多皮尔逊国际机场 (YYZ)、蒙特利尔-特鲁多国际机场 (YUL) 和温哥华国际机场 (YVR)。其第一个变更将是临时性的，仅在 11 月份安排少量往返多伦多和菲尼克斯 (PHX) 的波音 787-8 航班。梦想飞机此前曾执飞该航线，该航空公司在 2023/24 冬季期间每天运营 787-9 架飞机。
12 月将新增 5 条 787 航线。从 12 月 1 日起，该航空公司往返于温哥华和坎昆 (CUN) 之间的每日航班将从波音 737 MAX 8 改用 787-9，而蒙特利尔 - 基多和多伦多 - 基多航班则分别于 12 月 4 日和 5 日使用 787-8 返航。
多伦多-巴塞罗那 (BCN) 通常是一条夏季航线，最初计划在 12 月 16 日至 1 月 9 日之间每周接收 3 趟 787-8 航班。不过，在假期期间，这将增加到每天一班，同时使用 787-8 和 787-9。温哥华-札幌航线将于 12 月 17 日开通，每周提供三班波音 787-9 航班。
其余五次变更将在 2027 年夏季进行。温哥华至广州航线于 5 月 4 日开通，蒙特利尔至杜布罗夫尼克航线于 5 月 11 日开通，两条航线每周运营 3 趟。蒙特利尔-特拉维夫 (TLV) 也将于 5 月恢复运营，每周运营 3 趟 787-9 航班。多伦多-布拉格 (PRG) 和多伦多-斯德哥尔摩 (ARN) 将分别于 5 月和 6 月改用 787-9。
亚洲、欧洲和南美洲的新目的地
温哥华至广州航线全长 6,340 英里（10,203 公里），是 11 条航线中最长的航线，将成为继北京和上海之后加航在中国大陆的第三个目的地。该航空公司将成为唯一一家为广州提供服务的北美航空公司，尽管它将面临来自已经开通广州和温哥华航班的中国南方航空的竞争。
加拿大航空在宣布温哥华-札幌航线时表示，这将是北美和北海道之间唯一的直飞航班。然而，联合航空此后宣布将于 12 月 11 日（即加拿大航空首航前六天）推出每周三趟从旧金山出发的 787-9 航班。加拿大航空最初计划使用 787-8，但其最新时刻表更新显示，每趟航班均由 787-9 执飞。
杜布罗夫尼克将标志着加拿大航空自 2019 年夏季以来首次返回克罗地亚。该季节性航班将运营至 10 月 24 日，使用较小的 787-8。与此同时，基多将自 2020 年 3 月以来首次重新加入加拿大航空的网络。
该航空公司此前使用加航 Rouge 波音 767-300 运营从多伦多出发的季节性航班，但在疫情爆发时暂停了该服务。该公司将成为唯一一家在加拿大和厄瓜多尔之间提供直飞航班的航空公司，航班从蒙特利尔和多伦多起飞，直至 2027 年 3 月。
乘客在加拿大航空的波音 787 上可以期待什么
加拿大航空的波音 787-8 和 787-9 均提供三种舱等，包括 Signature 舱（商务舱）、Premium Economy 和 Economy。 787-8 拥有 20 个尊享舱座位、21 个豪华经济舱座位和 214 个经济舱座位，而较大的 787-9 则将载客量增至 30 个尊享舱座位、21 个豪华经济舱座位和 247 个经济舱座位。
Signature 舱设有 1-2-1 布局的平躺式商务舱座椅，让每位乘客都能直接进入过道。豪华经济舱采用 2-3-2 布局，而经济舱则采用 3-3-3 布局。加拿大航空目前运营 40 架波音 787，其中包括 8 架 787-8 和 32 787-9。它还订购了 14 架波音 787-10，第一架预计将于 2026 年底左右抵达。

Southwest, which is one of the largest airlines in the world by fleet size and passengers carried, has shown no signs of slowing down as it continues to develop its Nashville International Airport (BNA) hub.

Southwest Airlines Continues To Expand Its Network From Nashville

Southwest has been investing heavily in Nashville, fueling a rapid expansion of its operating network from the city. This comes as the airline taps into the growing business and leisure market from the city.

Beginning on January 6, the airline will add services from Nashville to Des Moines International Airport (DSM) and Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport (ICT), which are planned to operate year-round. These services will operate nonstop and complement the existing 72 year-round services and 18 seasonal routes.

Data from The Frequent Flyer suggests that Southwest is the largest airline at Nashville, operating more than 56% of all scheduled flights at the airport between June 2025 and May 2026. American Airlines is the second-largest operator, with 12.9% of all flights, and Delta Air Lines is at 11.5%. Details of Southwest's new Nashville services are below
Austin Gains Two New Southwest Airlines Destinations

At Austin Bergstrom International Airport (AUS), Southwest will add a new link to Fort Myers (RSW), with the new flight operating seasonally from March. The flight will operate once weekly on Saturdays, providing a new way to travel to the popular Florida holiday destination. Southwest will become the second airline to operate on the city pair, with Delta also introducing seasonal flights to Fort Myers from this November .

Southwest will also add Palm Springs (PSP) back to its seasonal network from Austin, with the airline operating the route daily in 2027 using its Boeing 737 aircraft. The airline had operated the route in a limited capacity for a brief period; however, it will reintroduce the service on January 2.

Both Southwest and Delta are responding to demand in Austin as the city has become one of the fastest-growing regions in the country. Many large tech companies have set up offices in the city, including Tesla, Google, and Amazon. This has fueled high-end business and leisure demand. The local airport is also going through a multi-billion-dollar expansion and upgrade program .

西南航空一直在纳什维尔投入巨资，推动其运营网络从该市快速扩张。此举正值该航空公司进军该城市不断增长的商务和休闲市场之际。
从 1 月 6 日开始，该航空公司将增加从纳什维尔飞往得梅因国际机场 (DSM) 和威奇托德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔国家机场 (ICT) 的航班，这些航班计划全年运营。这些航班将直达运营，并补充现有的 72 条全年航班和 18 条季节性航线。
来自飞行常客的数据显示，西南航空是纳什维尔最大的航空公司，2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 5 月期间运营着该机场所有定期航班的 56% 以上。美国航空是第二大运营商，占所有航班的 12.9%，达美航空为 11.5%。西南航空新纳什维尔航班的详细信息如下
西南航空获得奥斯汀两个新目的地
西南航空将在奥斯汀伯格斯特罗姆国际机场 (AUS) 增设一条飞往迈尔斯堡 (RSW) 的新航线，新航班从 3 月起按季节运营。该航班将每周在周六运营一班，为前往佛罗里达州热门度假胜地提供一种新的方式。西南航空将成为第二家在这两个城市运营的航空公司，达美航空也从今年 11 月起推出飞往迈尔斯堡的季节性航班。

由于奥斯汀已成为美国发展最快的地区之一，西南航空和达美航空都在响应奥斯汀的需求。许多大型科技公司都在该市设立了办事处，包括特斯拉、谷歌和亚马逊。这刺激了高端商务和休闲需求。当地机场也正在进行耗资数十亿美元的扩建和升级计划。

title_en: American Airlines Expected To Nearly Double Size Of Philadelphia Flagship Lounge
title_zh: 美国航空预计将费城旗舰休息室的面积扩大近一倍
summary: Philadelphia Flagship and Admirals Club rumored to merge into a mezzanine complex ahead of summer travel surge.

body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

The world's largest airline by passenger volume, American Airlines is eyeing a Flagship Lounge expansion at Philadelphia International Airport (PHL). American is considering absorbing the airport's Philadelphia A West Admirals Club into its Flagship as soon as March next year. These plans, which have been analyzed by View From The Wing and Inside Flyer , came to light when a lounge staff member made comments to a visiting passenger.
The airline has confirmed publicly, However, the airline has confirmed publicly that no lounge plans are final and that the proposed expansion plan could double the total Flagship space.
Merging Two American Airlines Lounges To Make One

With these plans having the potential to be completed by the Spring, this would prepare the airline ahead of the summer peak. The current Flagship lounge covers a total of 12,500 square feet (1,161 square meters) and has the capacity to seat 200 guests. Its neighboring Admirals A West Club covers a total of 11,000 square feet (1,021 square meters) and has the capacity for up to 181 guests.

The two lounges are already connected, but with the plans for a full takeover by Flagship of the Admirals Club, the two lounges would merge into a large 25,000 square feet (2,322 square meters) complex.
Simple Flying reached out to the airline for comment and further details on the plan; however, an airline spokesperson could not immediately be reached.
American Considers The Lounge Takeover To Address Overcrowding

For the oneworld carrier, the consideration to merge both the Flagship and Admirals Club lounges would address the steady increase in overcrowding that is seen during the airport's transatlantic departure bank. During the summer, American boosts its European schedule, adding hundreds of flights across the Northern Hemisphere summer season.

This results in thousands more weekly passengers through the airport terminals, and frequent flyers or those eligible for lounge access are putting a strain on the current setup. American is now considering the takeover of the Admirals Club to address this demand before the next seasonal rush. Below is the full list of year-round and seasonal transatlantic services offered by American from Philadelphia
Amsterdam (AMS), Dublin (DUB), Lisbon (LIS), London–Heathrow (LHR), Madrid (MAD), Paris–Charles de Gaulle (CDG), Rome–Fiumicino (FCO), Zurich (ZRH)
Athens (ATH), Budapest (BUD), Copenhagen (CPH), Edinburgh (EDI), Milan–Malpensa (MXP), Naples (NAP), Nice (NCE), Prague (PRG), Venice (VCE)
Next summer, additional new seasonal services will be added to Porto (OPO) from March 28, Vienna International Airport (VIE) from May 6, and Reykjavik (KEF) on May 27.

Philadelphia is an important base for American, with more than 300 flights recorded daily. It remains the busiest airport in the state of Pennsylvania, and one of the busiest airports in the United States. It is a major airport for the airline's European network.
What the PHL Lounge Expansion Means For Passengers

With the airline still to confirm whether the lounge takeover will proceed, the move would provide additional Flagship seating for its premium travelers. As a result, this would leave those members who currently access the Admirals A West lounge forced to take a longer walk to the Admirals Club available in B and C.

Philadelphia Terminal A is the primary international terminal, with both the American Airlines Flagship and Admirals Club. Other lounges include British Airways Galleries Lounge and American Express Centurion Lounge . Nearby, Terminals B and C are used for the majority of domestic and other short-haul international flights.

The current Terminal A Admirals Club is open from 5:00 AM through to 10:00 PM daily, and provides complimentary food and drinks, a full-service bar, free Wi-Fi, and showers. There are no conference rooms available. Next door, at the Flagship Lounge, this facility remains open from 8:00 AM to 9:30 PM. Both of these lounges are located on the mezzanine level between Gates A15 and A16.

Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。

作为全球客运量最大的航空公司，美国航空 (American Airlines) 正在考虑扩建费城国际机场 (PHL) 的旗舰休息室。美国航空正在考虑最早于明年 3 月将机场的费城 A West Admirals Club 纳入其旗舰店。这些计划已由 View From The Wing 和 Inside Flyer 分析，是在一名休息室工作人员向来访的乘客发表评论时曝光的。
该航空公司已公开证实，不过，该航空公司已公开证实，休息室计划尚未最终确定，拟议的扩建计划可能会使旗舰总空间增加一倍。
将两个美国航空休息室合并为一个
由于这些计划有可能在春季完成，这将使航空公司在夏季高峰之前做好准备。目前的旗舰休息室总面积为 12,500 平方英尺（1,161 平方米），可容纳 200 名客人。邻近的 Admirals A West 俱乐部占地 11,000 平方英尺（1,021 平方米），最多可容纳 181 位客人。
两个休息室已经相连，但随着海军上将俱乐部旗舰店计划全面接管，两个休息室将合并成一个 25,000 平方英尺（2,322 平方米）的大型综合体。
Simple Flying 联系了该航空公司以征求意见并了解有关该计划的更多细节；不过，无法立即联系到航空公司发言人。
美国航空考虑接管休息室以解决过度拥挤问题
对于寰宇一家航空公司来说，考虑合并旗舰休息室和海军上将俱乐部休息室将解决机场跨大西洋出发银行日益拥挤的问题。夏季，美国航空增加了其欧洲航线，在北半球夏季增加了数百个航班。
这导致每周有数千名乘客通过机场航站楼，而常旅客或有资格使用休息室的人给当前的设置带来了压力。美国航空目前正在考虑收购海军上将俱乐部，以便在下一个季节性高峰到来之前满足这一需求。以下是美国航空提供的从费城出发的全年和季节性跨大西洋航班的完整列表
阿姆斯特丹 (AMS)、都柏林 (DUB)、里斯本 (LIS)、伦敦-希思罗机场 (LHR)、马德里 (MAD)、巴黎-戴高乐机场 (CDG)、罗马-菲乌米奇诺 (FCO)、苏黎世 (ZRH)
雅典 (ATH)、布达佩斯 (BUD)、哥本哈根 (CPH)、爱丁堡 (EDI)、米兰-马尔本萨 (MXP)、那不勒斯 (NAP)、尼斯 (NCE)、布拉格 (PRG)、威尼斯 (VCE)
明年夏天，将从 3 月 28 日起新​​增飞往波尔图 (OPO)、从 5 月 6 日起飞往维也纳国际机场 (VIE) 以及从 5 月 27 日起飞往雷克雅未克 (KEF) 的额外新季节性航班。
费城是美国航空的重要基地，每天有超过 300 架次航班。它仍然是宾夕法尼亚州最繁忙的机场，也是美国最繁忙的机场之一。它是该航空公司欧洲网络的主要机场。
PHL 休息室扩建对乘客意味着什么
由于该航空公司仍在确认是否会继续进行休息室接管，此举将为其高端旅客提供额外的旗舰座位。因此，目前进入 Admirals A West 休息室的会员将被迫步行更长的距离才能到达位于 B 和 C 的 Admirals Club。
费城 A 航站楼是主要的国际航站楼，设有美国航空旗舰店和海军上将俱乐部。其他休息室包括英国航空画廊休息室和美国运通百夫长休息室。附近的 B 和 C 航站楼用于大多数国内和其他短途国际航班。
目前的 A 航站楼海军上将俱乐部每天营业时间为上午 5:00 至晚上 10:00，提供免费食品和饮料、全方位服务的酒吧、免费 Wi-Fi 和淋浴。没有可用的会议室。该设施位于隔壁的旗舰休息室，营业时间为上午 8:00 至晚上 9:30。这两个休息室均位于 A15 和 A16 登机口之间的夹层。

title_en: No More 747s: Even Boeing Admits That The "Future Of Freighters" Is Twin-Engine Jets

While living in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, the author had the great pleasure of having an eighth-floor apartment with an excellent view of the Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN), the country's largest and busiest airport. It was always amazing to watch the aircraft taxi, routinely queue up, and take off for their destinations.

Aside from the ubiquitous passenger jets operating at Tan Son Nhat, cargo planes were also a regular sight. Two operators that the author would frequently see, were Cargolux Airlines International and Asiana Cargo (a subsidiary of Asiana Airlines). An interesting facet of watching these cargo carriers was that they operated Boeing 747s. Watching these massive, lumbering giants taxi and dwarf the other aircraft and ground vehicles was always amusing.

While these enormous aircraft have been a mainstay of global logistics and commercial passenger travel for decades, their remarkable production run has come to a close. The final delivery of the 747 was made in 2023, ending roughly 50 years of production. These storied aircraft have increasingly been displaced by the twin-engine Boeing 777 Freighter, which offers greater fuel efficiency and range. The future looks bright for the latter, as Boeing predicts a massive surge in the global freighter fleet.
The 747, A Longtime Staple of Global Air Freight, Will Fade Away

The 747 was initially intended to serve as a short-term bridge between conventional jet travel and the expected arrival of supersonic commercial flight. Pan American World Airways (Pan Am) operated the aircraft's first scheduled commercial passenger flight. Regarding this historic service, the Pan Am Museum notes that it took place on " . . .January 22, 1970, when it carried 335 passengers and 20 crew members from New York’s JFK Airport to London Heathrow (LHR) ." Following its introduction into commercial service, Boeing states that more than 100 customers have purchased 1,574 aircraft, which have logged more than 118 million flight hours and nearly 23 million flight cycles.

In the nearly six decades since production began, the 747 has seen numerous iterations. While best known as a passenger airliner, its design also incorporated features intended to accommodate oversized cargo . Speaking to this history, the Northwest Airlines History Center explains that a ". . .high fuselage and long body was the heart of Boeing’s heavy-lift- proposal to the U.S. Air Force in the 1960s - but Lockheed would win the competition with their C-5 Galaxy." To adapt the aircraft for commercial use, the " . . .rear ramp and high wing were traded for a conventional layout, but the option for nose loading was retained - pushing the cockpit above the main deck and creating the distinctive “hump” and upper-deck cabin."

Given that Boeing incorporated cargo-handling considerations into the aircraft's design from the outset, it should come as little surprise that the first dedicated cargo variant, the 747-200F, was delivered to Lufthansa on March 9, 1972 , marking the beginning of a new era in air cargo transportation.

Air Cargo Week notes that the 200F could carry nearly three times the amount of cargo on a single flight as its predecessor, the Boeing 707 Freighter. The latter could accommodate roughly 74,957 lb (34,000 kg) of freight, compared with the 231,485 lb (104,999 kg) carried by the former. As a result, the 200F became considerably more profitable for cargo carriers over the long term, despite the higher fuel and capital costs associated with its operation.

The final purpose-built freighter variant of the 747 family was the 747-8F . The 8F entered the market at a time when the jumbo jet was increasingly being phased out in favor of more economical twin-engine freighters, such as the 777F. Illustrating this industry shift, Air Cargo Week reported in March 2026 that Boeing had sold a total of 362, 777Fs following its entry into the market in 2009. This was more than triple the total sales of the 747-8F during its 16 years on the market (2005-2021), during which time 109 8Fs were sold.
Less Is More, Twin-Engine Aircraft Are Defining The Future Of Airfreight

At first glance, moving from an aircraft that can carry an enormous amount of freight to one with a comparatively lower payload might seem illogical. Yet, as seen above, this transition has been underway for more than 15 years. To highlight the difference in cargo-carrying capacity, Atlas Air lists the 747-400F's maximum revenue payload at 249,100 lb (112,900 kg), while Boeing lists the 777F's maximum payload at 235,895 lb (107,000 kg). Why leave the Jumbo Jet behind? The answer lies in range and fuel efficiency.

Although the 747-400F offered greater cargo-carrying capacity, its published range was shorter. Atlas Air lists the aircraft's maximum design range at 4,455 nautical miles (8,250 km), roughly the distance from New York City to Istanbul, Türkiye. By comparison, the 777F has a range of 5,000 nautical miles (9,260 km) with a 235,895 lb (107,000 kg) payload, approximately the distance from Los Angeles to London. Added to this extended range is improved fuel efficiency. The Government Accountability Office notes that the ". . .Boeing 777 can be as much as 30 percent more fuel-efficient than older model Boeing 747s." However, this comparison concerns passenger aircraft and measures fuel efficiency on a per-seat basis, rather than comparing dedicated freighters.

The 777F's growing prominence illustrates the industry's shift toward newer twin-engine freighters. Air Cargo Week —quoting Boeing—has stated that its 777F fleet carried US$4 trillion in global trade in 2025 and represents around 40% of global freighter capacity. The 777F has also overtaken the 747 as the world's most widely operated freighter type, marking a significant shift in the global air cargo industry .
body_zh: 克里斯在德克萨斯大学埃尔帕索分校获得了国防和战略研究硕士学位（最高荣誉）。
他的研究生工作主要集中在全球和国家安全、低强度冲突、现代战争和美国大战略。
他还进行了广泛的地区研究，分析关键地区如何融入更广泛的美国安全架构。
这个严格的项目使他对美国的军事行动、全球战略和武器系统有了全面的了解。
此外，他对大国竞争产生了强烈的认识——在可预见的未来，这种竞争将成为塑造国际关系和冲突的日益重要的力量。
在越南胡志明市居住期间，作者很高兴拥有一套八楼的公寓，可以欣赏该国最大、最繁忙的机场——新山一国际机场 (SGN) 的美景。看着飞机滑行、例行排队、起飞前往目的地总是令人惊叹。
除了新山一机场随处可见的客机外，货机也是常见的景象。笔者经常见到的两家运营商是Cargolux Airlines International 和Asiana Cargo（韩亚航空的子公司）。观察这些货运公司的一个有趣的方面是它们运营的是波音 747。看着这些巨大而笨重的巨人滑行并使其他飞机和地面车辆相形见绌总是很有趣的。
尽管这些巨大的飞机几十年来一直是全球物流和商业客运的中流砥柱，但它们出色的生产运行已接近尾声。 747 的最终交付于 2023 年完成，结束了大约 50 年的生产。这些传奇飞机越来越多地被双引擎波音 777 货机取代，后者具有更高的燃油效率和航程。后者的未来看起来很光明，因为波音公司预测全球货机机队将大幅增加。
长期以来全球航空货运的主力机型 747 将逐渐消失

747 最初的目的是作为传统喷气式飞机旅行和预期到来的超音速商业航班之间的短期桥梁。泛美世界航空公司（Pan Am）运营了该飞机的首个定期商业客运航班。关于这一历史性的服务，泛美博物馆指出，它发生在“……1970 年 1 月 22 日，当时载有 335 名乘客和 20 名机组人员从纽约肯尼迪机场飞往伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR)”。波音公司表示，在其投入商业服务后，已有 100 多家客户购买了 1,574 架飞机，这些飞机的飞行时间超过 1.18 亿小时，飞行周期近 2300 万次。

自生产以来的近 6 年里，747 经历了无数次迭代。虽然最著名的是客机，但其设计还融入了容纳超大货物的功能。谈到这段历史，西北航空历史中心解释说，“……高机身和长机身是波音公司在 20 世纪 60 年代向美国空军提出的重型运输方案的核心，但洛克希德公司凭借其 C-5 Galaxy 赢得了竞争。”为了使飞机适应商业用途，“……后坡道和高机翼被换成了传统布局，但保留了机头装载的选项——将驾驶舱推到主甲板上方，形成独特的“驼峰”和上层甲板客舱。”
鉴于波音公司从一开始就将货物装卸考虑纳入了飞机的设计中，因此第一架专用货运飞机 747-200F 于 1972 年 3 月 9 日交付给汉莎航空也就不足为奇了，这标志着航空货运新时代的开始。
《航空货运周刊》指出，200F 单次航班的载货量几乎是其前身波音 707 货机的三倍。后者可承载大约 74,957 磅（34,000 公斤）的货物，而前者可承载 231,485 磅（104,999 公斤）的货物。因此，尽管 200F 的运营带来更高的燃料和资本成本，但从长远来看，200F 为货运公司带来的利润显着提高。

747 系列最后一款专用货机型号是 747-8F。 8F 进入市场之际，大型喷气式客机正逐渐被淘汰，取而代之的是更经济的双引擎货机，例如 777F。 《航空货运周刊》在 2026 年 3 月报道称，波音自 2009 年进入市场以来，已售出 362 架 777F，这说明了这一行业转变。这是 747-8F 上市 16 年（2005 年至 2021 年）期间总销量的三倍多，在此期间售出了 109 架 8F。
少即是多，双引擎飞机正在定义航空货运的未来
乍一看，从能够运载大量货物的飞机转向有效载荷相对较低的飞机似乎不合逻辑。然而，如上所示，这种转变已经进行了 15 年多。为了突出载货能力的差异，阿特拉斯航空将 747-400F 的最大有效载荷列为 249,100 磅（112,900 公斤），而波音将 777F 的最大有效载荷列为 235,895 磅（107,000 公斤）。为什么要把大型喷气式飞机抛在后面？答案在于续航里程和燃油效率。
追踪天空最有趣的时刻，直播
等待、改航和稀有飞机，一目了然。免费，无需注册。

尽管 747-400F 提供了更大的载货能力，但其公布的航程较短。阿特拉斯航空列出该飞机的最大设计航程为 4,455 海里（8,250 公里），大致相当于从纽约市到土耳其伊斯坦布尔的距离。相比之下，777F 的航程为 5,000 海里（9,260 公里），有效载荷为 235,895 磅（107,000 公斤），大约是从洛杉矶到伦敦的距离。除了延长航程之外，还提高了燃油效率。政府问责办公室指出，“……波音 777 的燃油效率比旧型号波音 747 提高了 30%。”然而，这种比较涉及客机并按每个座位衡量燃油效率，而不是比较专用货机。
777F 的日益突出表明该行业正在转向新型双引擎货机。 《航空货运周刊》援引波音公司的话说，其 777F 机队到 2025 年将承担 4 万亿美元的全球贸易额，约占全球货运能力的 40%。 777F 还取代 747 成为全球运营最广泛的货机类型，标志着全球航空货运业的重大转变。

title_en: 3 New Routes, 1 New Destination: JetBlue Expands Its Network Today
title_zh: 3 条新航线、1 个新目的地：捷蓝航空今日扩展其网络
summary: JetBlue launches three routes today, adding Indianapolis to its network as Fort Lauderdale becomes its busiest airport.
summary_zh: 捷蓝航空今天推出了三条航线，随着劳德代尔堡成为其最繁忙的机场，印第安纳波利斯也加入了其网络。
body_en: 3 New Routes, 1 New Destination: JetBlue Expands Its Network Today

Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

JetBlue is launching three new nonstop routes today , expanding its network with two services from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) and another connecting Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI) with San Juan. The new additions bring Columbus back into its network and introduce Indianapolis as an entirely new destination for the airline. All three routes will operate daily using Airbus A320 aircraft.

The launches come amid a significant transformation of JetBlue's network, with Fort Lauderdale recently overtaking New York JFK as its busiest airport . The airline is capitalizing on the demise of Spirit Airlines to expand its South Florida presence, while preparing to introduce additional premium transcontinental services later this month.

JetBlue's latest expansion introduces daily nonstop flights from Fort Lauderdale to Indianapolis International Airport (IND) and John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH). The two new services are part of a broader expansion announced earlier this year, when the airline outlined plans to add 11 destinations from the South Florida airport.

Indianapolis represents the biggest milestone, becoming a new city in JetBlue's network. Columbus, meanwhile, welcomes the carrier back after an absence, giving travelers another option for reaching South Florida. The additions strengthen JetBlue's domestic connectivity from Fort Lauderdale, where the airline has been expanding aggressively throughout 2026 . JetBlue CEO, Joanna Geraghty, had the following to say

"We're building on our already strong foundation by adding more destinations, creating more connections and giving customers even more reasons to choose JetBlue. As Fort Lauderdale's leading airline, we see an opportunity to continue growing together with this community."

The new route from Baltimore to San Juan's Luis Munoz Marin International Airport (SJU) builds on JetBlue's return to Baltimore back in July, when it introduced three daily flights to Fort Lauderdale. The new Puerto Rico service expands its reach from Maryland while reinforcing San Juan's importance within the airline's Caribbean network. Baltimore airport officials welcomed JetBlue's arrival, emphasizing the benefits of additional competition and connectivity .
Fort Lauderdale Overtakes JFK As JetBlue's Busiest Airport

The Fort Lauderdale expansion has led to it becoming JetBlue's busiest airport by scheduled departures, overtaking its longtime New York JFK Airport (JFK) stronghold. The change illustrates how dramatically the airline's network has shifted toward South Florida. Based on the winter schedule figures highlighted in a recent Simple Flying analysis of JetBlue's network changes , Fort Lauderdale now leads JFK by approximately six daily departures.

The expansion has been accelerated by Spirit Airlines' collapse and JetBlue's changing route network. JetBlue has introduced 15 destinations from Fort Lauderdale while increasing frequencies on existing routes. Its share of scheduled seats at the airport is expected to reach approximately 37% in the fourth quarter, an increase of 14 percentage points year-over-year. Peak daily departures will also exceed 150 this winter.

Crucially, the expansion is also delivering encouraging financial results . During the third quarter, Fort Lauderdale revenue per available seat mile (RASM) increased nearly 15% despite capacity growing by more than 65%. The expansion is also driving increased ancillary revenue, with co-branded credit card acquisitions in the region up 55%. The airline expects the maturing Fort Lauderdale operation to generate further unit revenue improvements as capacity growth moderates.
JetBlue's Next Fort Lauderdale Expansion Will Feature Mint

JetBlue's next significant Fort Lauderdale launch is scheduled for later this month on November 19, when daily nonstop flights to San Diego International Airport (SAN) begin. The route will feature the airline's premium JetBlue Mint business class, including fully lie-flat seating. This will give the airline a distinct advantage over Southwest Airlines and Alaska Airlines , which also operate the route, by making it the only airline with a lie-flat offering between the two airports.

The San Diego launch is part of a much wider transcontinental push. JetBlue is also adding Mint-equipped flights to Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) and San Francisco International Airport (SFO) this winter, creating its largest-ever Mint schedule from Fort Lauderdale. The airline ultimately plans to offer up to eight daily flights to Los Angeles and three to San Francisco, although these totals include services without Mint.

The premium expansion signals JetBlue's ambition to transform Fort Lauderdale into more than a gateway for leisure travelers heading to Florida and the Caribbean. By adding lie-flat business class capacity on key West Coast routes, the airline hopes to capture higher-yield passengers while differentiating itself from competitors. Combined with today's new domestic and Caribbean routes, the Mint expansion demonstrates how central Fort Lauderdale has become to JetBlue's future growth strategy.
body_zh: 3 条新航线、1 个新目的地：捷蓝航空今日扩展其网络
Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍布 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
捷蓝航空今天推出三条新的直达航线，扩大其网络，两条航线从劳德代尔堡好莱坞国际机场 (FLL) 出发，另一条航线连接巴尔的摩/华盛顿瑟古德马歇尔机场 (BWI) 和圣胡安。新增加的航班使哥伦布重新回归其网络，并将印第安纳波利斯引入该航空公司的全新目的地。所有这三条航线每天都将使用空客 A320 飞机运营。
这些服务的推出正值捷蓝航空网络发生重大转型之际，劳德代尔堡最近取代纽约肯尼迪机场成为捷蓝航空最繁忙的机场。该航空公司正在利用精神航空的倒闭扩大其在南佛罗里达州的业务，同时准备在本月晚些时候推出额外的优质跨大陆服务。
捷蓝航空最新的扩建项目推出了每日从劳德代尔堡飞往印第安纳波利斯国际机场 (IND) 和约翰·格伦哥伦布国际机场 (CMH) 的直飞航班。这两项新服务是今年早些时候宣布的更广泛扩张计划的一部分，当时该航空公司概述了从南佛罗里达机场增加 11 个目的地的计划。
印第安纳波利斯是最重要的里程碑，成为捷蓝航空网络中的一个新城市。与此同时，哥伦布欢迎该航空公司在缺席后回归，为旅客提供了到达南佛罗里达州的另一种选择。这些新增服务加强了捷蓝航空从劳德代尔堡出发的国内航班连接，该航空公司在 2026 年一直在劳德代尔堡积极扩张。捷蓝航空首席执行官乔安娜·杰拉蒂 (Joanna Geraghty) 表示：
“我们正在通过增加更多目的地、创造更多联系以及为客户提供更多选择捷蓝航空的理由，在已经坚实的基础上再接再厉。作为劳德代尔堡的领先航空公司，我们看到了与这个社区共同发展的机会。”
从巴尔的摩飞往圣胡安路易斯·穆尼奥斯·马林国际机场 (SJU) 的新航线是在 7 月份捷蓝航空重返巴尔的摩的基础上开通的，当时捷蓝航空推出了每日 3 趟飞往劳德代尔堡的航班。新的波多黎各航线扩大了从马里兰州出发的航线范围，同时加强了圣胡安在该航空公司加勒比航线网络中的重要性。巴尔的摩机场官员对捷蓝航空的到来表示欢迎，强调了额外竞争和连通性的好处。
劳德代尔堡取代肯尼迪机场成为捷蓝航空最繁忙的机场
劳德代尔堡的扩建使其成为捷蓝航空最繁忙的机场，超过了其长期占据的纽约肯尼迪机场 (JFK)。这一变化表明该航空公司的网络已向南佛罗里达州转移。根据最近对捷蓝航空网络变化进行的 Simple Flying 分析中强调的冬季时刻表数据，劳德代尔堡现在每天比肯尼迪机场领先大约 6 个航班。
精神航空的倒闭和捷蓝航空航线网络的变化加速了扩张。捷蓝航空已开通 15 个从劳德代尔堡出发的目的地，同时增加现有航线的班次。预计第四季度其机场预定座位份额将达到约37%，同比增长14个百分点。今年冬季，每日出发高峰期也将超过150班。
至关重要的是，扩张还带来了令人鼓舞的财务业绩。第三季度，劳德代尔堡的每可用座位英里收入 (RASM) 增长了近 15%，尽管运力增长了 65% 以上。这一扩张还推动了辅助收入的增加，该地区的联合品牌信用卡收购量增长了 55%。该航空公司预计，随着运力增长放缓，日渐成熟的劳德代尔堡运营将进一步提高单位收入。
捷蓝航空在劳德代尔堡的下一次扩建将以 Mint 为特色
捷蓝航空定于本月晚些时候（即 11 月 19 日）在劳德代尔堡推出下一次重大航班，届时每天将开通飞往圣地亚哥国际机场 (SAN) 的直达航班。该航线将配备该航空公司的优质捷蓝薄荷商务舱，包括完全平躺的座椅。这将使该航空公司相对于同样运营该航线的西南航空和阿拉斯加航空具有明显的优势，使其成为唯一一家在两个机场之间提供平躺服务的航空公司。
圣地亚哥的发射是更广泛的跨大陆推动的一部分。捷蓝航空今年冬季还将增加飞往洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) 和旧金山国际机场 (SFO) 的配备 Mint 的航班，打造从劳德代尔堡出发的有史以来最大的 Mint 航班时刻表。该航空公司最终计划每天提供最多 8 趟飞往洛杉矶的航班和 3 趟飞往旧金山的航班，尽管这些总数包括不包括 Mint 的航班。
此次溢价扩张标志着捷蓝航空希望将劳德代尔堡转变为休闲旅客前往佛罗里达和加勒比地区的门户。通过在西海岸主要航线上增加平躺商务舱的运力，该航空公司希望吸引更多的乘客，同时从竞争对手中脱颖而出。结合当今新的国内和加勒比航线，Mint 的扩建表明劳德代尔堡已成为捷蓝航空未来增长战略的核心。

title_en: How Many Flights In One Day? We Tracked A Wideroe Dash 8 For 24 Hours
title_zh: 一天有多少个航班？我们对 Wideroe Dash 8 进行了 24 小时追踪
summary: We tracked a Widerøe Dash 8 through 17 sectors in one day. The shortest flight lasted seven minutes.
summary_zh: 我们在一天内跟踪了 Widerøe Dash 8 的 17 个区域。最短的飞行持续了七分钟。
body_en: How Many Flights In One Day? We Tracked A Wideroe Dash 8 For 24 Hours

Brandon's passion for aviation started at a young age. He became involved in the flight simulator and VATSIM communities, which sparked his interest in aviation and eventually led him to earn his private pilot license. Outside of work, he continues to build flight hours, explore new airports, and stay involved in the aviation community.

On Wednesday, October 21, a Widerøe Bombardier Dash 8-100 registered LN-WIE flew 17 sectors between eight airports in Arctic Norway. It left Tromsø (TOS) at 04:12 UTC and finished at Lakselv (LKL) at 21:28, spending 8 hours and 34 minutes airborne across an elapsed day of 17 hours and 16 minutes. The shortest flight, Båtsfjord (BJF) to Vadsø (VDS), lasted seven minutes. Five sectors ran under 20 minutes. The aircraft returned to Hammerfest (HFT) five separate times.

None of it exists on commercial merit. These are public service obligation routes, tendered by the Norwegian government and operated under subsidy because no airline would fly them otherwise. Widerøe won all 13 PSO routes in the 2017 tender round, and the Dash 8-100 is the aircraft that makes the arrangement work at 39 seats on short Finnmark runways. Keeping those airframes flying has required De Havilland Canada to certify the type to 160,000 flight cycles, double its original design life and the highest of any commercial aircraft.

On Wednesday, October 21, a Widerøe Dash 8-100 registered LN-WIE operated 17 flights across eight airports in Arctic Norway. The aircraft departed Tromsø Airport (TOS) at 04:12 UTC and arrived at Lakselv Airport (LKL) at 21:28, a span of 17 hours and 16 minutes. We followed the rotation on Simple Flying's Live Flight Tracker , the same approach we took when tracking a Ryanair Boeing 737 through a full day of European short-haul flying.

The two days look nothing alike. LN-WIE spent 8 hours and 34 minutes airborne across its 17 flights, averaging just over 30 minutes per sector. The longest was Tromsø to Kirkenes (KKN) at 1 hour 7 minutes, the only flight of the day to exceed an hour. The shortest was Båtsfjord (BJF) to Vadsø (VDS) at seven minutes. Eleven of the 17 flights lasted 35 minutes or less, and the aircraft completed its first four sectors before 07:30 UTC.

The route pattern is equally unusual. The aircraft arrived at Hammerfest (HFT) five separate times and at Tromsø four, working between those two points and a cluster of smaller airports across Finnmark, Norway's northernmost county. It also reached Alta (ALF), Vardø (VAW), Vadsø, Båtsfjord, Kirkenes and finally Lakselv, where it finished the day rather than returning to where it started. Four of the eight airports were visited more than once. This is not point-to-point flying in any conventional sense. It is one aircraft circling back repeatedly through the same handful of fields , which is a pattern dictated by something other than commercial route planning.
Emergency squawks, holds, NOTAMs — unique signals, live, no signup.

The third sector of the day was Båtsfjord to Vadsø. The aircraft departed at 06:09 UTC and arrived at 06:17. Seven minutes airborne, which is shorter than the taxi time at most major airports. It is the kind of sector that exists nowhere in a conventional airline network, and on this day it was not even unusual.

Four other flights ran under 20 minutes. Vadsø to Båtsfjord in the opposite direction took 10 minutes that evening. Vardø to Vadsø took 11. Kirkenes to Vardø took 15. Hammerfest to Alta took 16. Five of the 17 sectors, nearly a third of the day's flying, lasted under 20 minutes, and together they accounted for 59 minutes of airborne time out of 514. Several were shorter than the turnaround that preceded them, inverting the usual relationship between time airborne and time on the ground.

These sectors are the reason the network exists in this form. The Bombardier Dash 8-100 is the backbone of Widerøe's public service obligation operation in Norway, particularly in the north . The routes connecting Vardø, Vadsø, Båtsfjord and the other Finnmark fields are subsidized by the Norwegian Ministry of Transport and Communications precisely because the distances involved and the populations served do not support commercial air service. The evening sequence makes the logic plain: Kirkenes to Vardø to Vadsø to Båtsfjord, three consecutive sectors totaling 36 minutes airborne, strung together to connect four communities in a single rotation. A seven-minute flight is not an inefficiency in the schedule. It is what the government contracted for.
The Aircraft Spent More Time Parked Than Flying

Across the full rotation, LN-WIE accumulated 8 hours and 34 minutes airborne against an elapsed day of 17 hours and 16 minutes. That leaves 8 hours and 42 minutes between sectors, marginally more time on the ground than in the air. For an aircraft operating 17 flights in a day, the arithmetic is counterintuitive until sector length is taken into account. When half the flights last under 35 minutes, turnaround time becomes the dominant constraint on how many sectors fit into a day.

The turnarounds were quick. The shortest was 18 minutes at Hammerfest, between arriving from Vadsø at 07:26 and departing for Tromsø at 07:44. Several others ran close: 20 minutes at Hammerfest later that morning, 20 minutes at Båtsfjord in the evening, and 22 minutes at Hammerfest, Alta and Vardø. Across the 16 turnarounds, nine were 30 minutes or less, and the median sat at roughly 23 minutes.

The two long stops were both at Tromsø. The aircraft sat for 78 minutes between arriving from Alta at 11:19 and departing for Hammerfest at 12:37, then 62 minutes in the early afternoon before operating to Kirkenes. Those two pauses account for more than two and a half hours of the day's ground time on their own, meaning the remaining 14 turnarounds averaged under half an hour between them. Everywhere else, the pattern held: land, turn, depart. Hammerfest saw the aircraft five times and Tromsø four, with the rotation repeatedly returning to both rather than progressing along a line. The final turnaround of the day, 34 minutes at Tromsø, preceded the 40-minute positioning sector to Lakselv.

None of these flights exist on commercial merit. They operate under public service obligation contracts, under which the Norwegian Ministry of Transport and Communications subsidizes air service on routes that would not otherwise be flown. Widerøe has held those contracts across the regional network, winning all 13 PSO routes in the 2017 tender round after the government determined it wanted a single operator across all subsidized regional routes in the country.
body_zh: 一天有多少个航班？我们对 Wideroe Dash 8 进行了 24 小时追踪
布兰登从小就对航空充满热情。他参与了飞行模拟器和 VATSIM 社区，这激发了他对航空的兴趣，并最终使他获得了私人飞行员执照。工作之余，他继续增加飞行时间、探索新机场并继续参与航空界。

10 月 21 日星期三，一架注册为 LN-WIE 的 Widerøe Bombardier Dash 8-100 在挪威北极地区的 8 个机场之间飞行了 17 个航段。它于世界标准时间 04:12 离开特罗姆瑟 (TOS)，并于 21:28 抵达拉克塞尔夫 (LKL)，在空中飞行了 8 小时 34 分钟，一天过去了 17 小时 16 分钟。最短的航班是从巴斯峡湾 (BJF) 飞往瓦德瑟 (VDS)，飞行时间为 7 分钟。有五个航段的运行时间不到 20 分钟。该飞机五次分别返回哈默菲斯特 (HFT)。

这些都没有商业价值。这些是公共服务义务航线，由挪威政府招标并在补贴下运营，因为否则没有航空公司愿意执飞这些航线。 Widerøe 在 2017 年招标中赢得了全部 13 条 PSO 航线，而 Dash 8-100 是在芬马克短跑道上实现 39 个座位安排的飞机。为了保持这些机身的飞行，加拿大德哈维兰公司需要对该型号进行 160,000 次飞行周期认证，这是其原始设计寿命的两倍，也是所有商用飞机中最高的。

10 月 21 日星期三，一架注册为 LN-WIE 的 Widerøe Dash 8-100 在挪威北极地区的 8 个机场运营了 17 趟航班。该飞机于世界标准时间 04:12 从特罗姆瑟机场 (TOS) 起飞，于 21:28 抵达拉克塞尔夫机场 (LKL)，历时 17 小时 16 分钟。我们跟踪了 Simple Flying 的实时航班跟踪器的轮换情况，这与我们在欧洲短途飞行一整天中跟踪瑞安航空波音 737 飞机时所采用的方法相同。

这两天看起来没什么相似之处。 LN-WIE 在 17 个航班中飞行了 8 小时 34 分钟，每个航段平均飞行时间略多于 30 分钟。最长的航班是特罗姆瑟飞往希尔科内斯 (KKN)，飞行时间为 1 小时 7 分钟，这是当天唯一超过一小时的航班。最短的是从巴斯峡湾 (BJF) 到瓦德瑟 (VDS)，只需 7 分钟。 17 次飞行中有 11 次持续时间不超过 35 分钟，飞机在 UTC 时间 07:30 之前完成了前四个航段。

路线模式同样不寻常。这架飞机五次分别抵达哈默菲斯特 (HFT)，四次抵达特罗姆瑟，往返于这两个地点和挪威最北端芬马克县的一系列小型机场之间。它还到达阿尔塔 (ALF)、瓦尔德 (VAW)、瓦德瑟、巴斯峡湾、希尔科内斯，最后到达拉克塞尔夫，在那里结束了一天的行程，而不是返回出发地。八个机场中有四个机场被多次访问。这不是任何传统意义上的点对点飞行。这是一架飞机在同一片土地上反复盘旋，这是一种由商业航线规划以外的因素决定的模式。
紧急尖叫、等待、航行通告 — 独特的信号，实时，无需注册。
当天的第三个航段是巴斯峡湾 (Båtsfjord) 至瓦德瑟 (Vadsø)。飞机于世界标准时间 06:09 起飞，并于 06:17 抵达。飞行时间为 7 分钟，比大多数主要机场的出租车时间都短。这种行业在传统的航空网络中根本不存在，而在今天，这种情况也并不罕见。

其他四趟航班飞行时间不到 20 分钟。当天晚上，瓦德索 (Vadsø) 沿相反方向前往巴斯峡湾 (Båtsfjord) 需要 10 分钟。瓦尔德到瓦德索需要 11 小时。希尔科内斯到瓦尔德需要 15 小时。哈默菲斯特到阿尔塔需要 16 小时。17 个航段中的 5 个航段，几乎占当天飞行的三分之一，持续时间不到 20 分钟，总共占 514 分钟的空中飞行时间中的 59 分钟。其中有几个航段比之前的周转时间短，颠倒了空中飞行时间和地面时间之间的通常关系。

这些部门是网络以这种形式存在的原因。庞巴迪 Dash 8-100 是 Widerøe 在挪威（尤其是北部地区）公共服务义务运营的支柱。连接瓦尔德、瓦德索、巴斯峡湾和其他芬马克地区的航线由挪威交通和通讯部提供补贴，正是因为所涉及的距离和服务的人口不支持商业航空服务。晚上的顺序使逻辑变得简单：希尔科内斯到瓦尔德到瓦德索到巴斯峡湾，三个连续的航段总共飞行 36 分钟，串在一起，在一个循环中连接四个社区。七分钟的飞行在时间表上并不是低效的。这是政府签订的合同。
飞机停放时间多于飞行时间
在整个旋转过程中，LN-WIE 累计飞行时间为 8 小时 34 分钟，而一天的飞行时间为 17 小时 16 分钟。这样航段之间的飞行时间为 8 小时 42 分钟，地面时间略多于空中时间。对于一天运营 17 趟航班的飞机来说，在考虑航段长度之前，该算法是违反直觉的。当一半的航班持续时间不足 35 分钟时，周转时间就成为一天内飞行航段的主要限制因素。
周转很快。哈默菲斯特最短时间为 18 分钟，从 07:26 从瓦德瑟抵达到 07:44 出发前往特罗姆瑟。其他几个也接近：当天早上晚些时候在哈默菲斯特 20 分钟，晚上在 Båtsfjord 20 分钟，以及哈默菲斯特、阿尔塔和瓦尔德 22 分钟。在 16 次周转中，有 9 次的周转时间为 30 分钟或更短，中位数约为 23 分钟。

两次长途停留均在特罗姆瑟。飞机于 11 点 19 分从阿尔塔抵达至 12 点 37 分飞往哈默菲斯特，飞行了 78 分钟，然后在下午早些时候飞行了 62 分钟，然后飞往希尔科内斯。这两次停顿本身就占了当天地面时间的两个半小时以上，这意味着其余 14 次停顿之间的平均时间不到半小时。在其他地方，都遵循这样的模式：着陆、转弯、离开。哈默菲斯特见证了这架飞机五次，特罗姆瑟见证了四次，其旋转反复返回到这两个地点，而不是沿着一条直线前进。当天的最后一次逆转是在特罗姆瑟进行的 34 分钟比赛，之后是前往拉克塞尔夫的 40 分钟定位赛段。
这些航班都不具有商业价值。它们根据公共服务义务合同运营，根据该合同，挪威运输和通讯部对原本不会飞行的航线上的航空服务提供补贴。 Widerøe 持有整个区域网络的这些合同，并在 2017 年招标中赢得了所有 13 条 PSO 线路，此前政府决定希望在该国所有补贴区域线路上采用单一运营商。

body_en: Twelve flights and a ‘Papacóptero’: Pope Leo XIV’s South American aviation itinerary - Aviation24.be

Pope Leo XIV’s visit to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru from 6 to 17 November will involve an unusually varied flying programme: 12 fixed-wing sectors and two scheduled helicopter journeys, combining airline widebodies, narrowbody jets and military transport. For aviation enthusiasts, the itinerary offers everything from an ITA Airways A330neo crossing the Atlantic to a Peruvian Air Force Mi-17 heading into the Andes. The Vatican’s published flight list identifies the operators for all 14 sectors, although some aircraft details remain unannounced.
From an Italian Airbus to an Argentine Boeing

ITA Airways will open the tour on 6 November with a non-stop Rome-Fiumicino–Montevideo flight aboard an Airbus A330neo . According to the airline’s announcement, reported by Aviacionline, the flight will carry three pilots and ten cabin crew, alongside the papal delegation and accompanying journalists. No individual aircraft registration has been identified in the announcements reviewed.

Uruguay’s air force will handle the return trip between Montevideo and Paysandú on 7 November, but the Vatican’s notice does not specify the aircraft type. Aerolíneas Argentinas then takes over: Boeing 737 MAX 8s are planned for Montevideo–Buenos Aires and the Córdoba return journey, followed by an Airbus A330-200 for Buenos Aires–Lima on 11 November. The Argentine operation also includes a separate cargo-only flight between Montevideo and Buenos Aires, outside the Pope’s own 12-sector tally.

Dates and operators follow the Vatican itinerary; aircraft assignments come from airline announcements and Peru’s official reporting. All remain subject to operational changes.

LATAM has confirmed an A320neo for the four domestic Peruvian sectors and a Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner for the non-stop return to Rome . Its busiest day will be 15 November, when three successive flights link Chiclayo, Cusco, Pucallpa and Lima — taking the delegation from the coast into the Andes, onwards to Amazonia and back to the capital. LATAM is preparing special interior and exterior details but has not disclosed exactly what they will involve.

The most distinctive aircraft is the “Papacóptero” , a Peruvian Air Force Mi-17 presented on 28 October for the Chiclayo–Santa Cruz de Succhabamba return journey. The support deployment includes three additional Mi-17s, Bell 212 and Bell 412 helicopters for aeromedical duties, and a pressurised Beechcraft King Air 360C air ambulance . These supporting aircraft should not be confused with additional scheduled flights carrying the Pope.

从意大利空客到阿根廷波音

乌拉圭空军将于11月7日执飞蒙得维的亚和派桑杜之间的返程航班，但梵蒂冈的通知并未具体说明飞机型号。随后，阿根廷航空公司接手：波音 737 MAX 8 计划执飞蒙得维的亚 - 布宜诺斯艾利斯和科尔多瓦往返航班，随后于 11 月 11 日由空客 A330-200 执飞布宜诺斯艾利斯 - 利马。阿根廷的运营还包括蒙得维的亚和布宜诺斯艾利斯之间的一个单独的货运航班，超出了教皇自己的 12 个航段的统计。

title_en: Rosewood Beyond Sale: 30% Off Stays, Plus Rosewood Elite Perks
title_zh: Rosewood Beyond Sale：住宿 30% 折扣，另加 Rosewood Elite 福利
summary: Rosewood is offering 30% off the best available rate through Rosewood Elite travel advisors for bookings made November 3-10, 2026, with stays valid through June 30, 2027.
summary_zh: 对于 2026 年 11 月 3 日至 10 日期间预订的瑰丽酒店，通过 Rosewood Elite 旅游顾问提供最优惠房价 30% 的折扣，且住宿有效期为 2026 年 11 月 3 日至 10 日。
body_en: Luxury hotel group Rosewood has just kicked off its best sale of the year, offering savings of up to 30%, and it’s exclusively available through Rosewood Elite travel advisors . If you’ve been considering a stay at a Rosewood, this would be a great time to book.
Rosewood’s best sale of the year returns for 2026
With the Rosewood Beyond promotion, guests can save 30% off the best available rate when booking a Rosewood property through a Rosewood Elite travel advisor. To cover the basics
The Rosewood Beyond sale is bookable for reservations confirmed between November 3 and November 10, 2026
The Rosewood Beyond sale is valid for stays through June 30, 2027
The Rosewood Beyond sale can only be booked through Rosewood Elite travel advisors, and can’t otherwise be booked directly by consumers

The Rosewood Beyond sale excludes the following properties: Rosewood Courchevel Le Jardin Alpin, Rosewood Calistoga, The Chancery Rosewood, New Zealand Collection: Rosewood Cape Kidnappers, Rosewood Kauri Cliffs, and Rosewood Matakauri
The Rosewood Beyond sale is subject to certain blackout dates and availability restrictions, and exclusions apply
The Rosewood Beyond sale excludes houses, penthouses, villas, and apartments

In order to take advantage of the Rosewood Beyond sale, you need to book through a Rosewood Elite travel advisor. Ford’s team is happy to help with this, and can be reached at ford@fordbtravel.com. Other travel advisors are welcome to leave their contact details in the comments as well.

Let me emphasize that the 30% discount is off the best available rate, otherwise known as the flexible rate. So you couldn’t get this discount on an advance purchase rate, third or fourth night free rate, etc. So in some situations the savings here won’t be that significant, while in other cases they are huge.

While there are of course some restrictions and blackout dates, this is about as no strings attached as promotions get. The 30% off rate also offers the same flexibility as whatever the flexible rate would be, which of course varies by property.
Since the Rosewood Beyond sale is specifically being offered through Rosewood Elite travel advisors, the good news is that these reservations also unlock additional benefits, including the following
Daily breakfast for up to two people per bedroom
A complimentary room upgrade upon arrival (based on availability)

An additional property specific elite enhanced amenities, which vary by property; these can include a $100 credit per stay, though you’ll want to check with a Rosewood Elite travel advisor to determine the property specific amenity available for your stay

Rosewood is a really high quality hotel brand, and you can find all the hotels here . If you’re looking for a getaway from the United States, it’s tough to beat the Rosewood Mayakoba, the Rosewood Little Dix Bay, the Rosewood Kona Village, Las Ventanas al Paraiso, etc. Rosewood also has lots of great city hotels, ranging from the Rosewood Hong Kong, to the Rosewood Sao Paulo, to The Carlyle New York.
Rosewood has brought back its biggest promotion of the year, offering 30% off the best available rate. This is valid for bookings confirmed November 3-10, 2026, and for stays through June 30, 2027.

Aside from a small list of excluded properties, this is a pretty straightforward offer that gives you the best deal you’ll find on Rosewood stays. You can even stack this with Rosewood Elite perks, to unlock breakfast, a property credit, a room upgrade, and more.
Just keep in mind that the discount is based on the flexible rate, and not based on any promotional rate you can find.

title_en: Most Versatile? Why Boeing Made The Iconic 747-400 Compatible With 3 Distinct Powerplants
title_zh: 最全能？为什么波音让标志性的 747-400 兼容 3 种不同的动力装置
summary: Today, the most modern aircraft stick to exclusive engine partnerships. The 747 defied this, offering 3 different engine options.
summary_zh: 如今，最现代的飞机都坚持独家发动机合作伙伴关系。 747 打破了这一点，提供了 3 种不同的发动机选项。
body_en: Most Versatile? Why Boeing Made The Iconic 747-400 Compatible With 3 Distinct Powerplants
Airline and Airport Management Graduate, Student Commercial Pilot and Commercial Aviation Writer.

In the late 1980s, as Boeing prepared to launch the definitive variant of its iconic jumbo jet, it handed airline customers an extraordinary level of operational control. Most other aircraft give global carriers a choice of just one or two engine manufacturers, but Boeing designed the 747-400 to seamlessly accommodate three completely distinct powerplants from three competing aerospace giants: General Electric , Pratt & Whitney , and Rolls-Royce . The tri-option compatibility allowed airlines to order the same four-engine widebody customized to their existing maintenance ecosystems, pilot type ratings, and regional manufacturer loyalties.

Integrating three radically different engine builds onto a single wing was a massive structural and financial undertaking. Each engine variant needed bespoke nacelle designs, flight deck indication logic, and expensive airworthiness certification flight tests. Why exactly did Boeing willingly absorb the staggering development costs required to certify three competing engines for a single aircraft program?

The biggest motivation behind offering three distinct engine options on the 747-400 was securing commercial market dominance by removing barriers to purchase. During the late 1980s, major long-haul carriers had fierce loyalty to specific engine manufacturers based on existing overhaul infrastructure and local supply chains. As highlighted by Simple Flying , ensuring that General Electric, Pratt & Whitney, and Rolls-Royce were all available on the airframe meant that engine preference never became a reason for an airline to look toward competing widebody designs.

Boeing certified the 747-400 with the Pratt & Whitney PW4056, the General Electric CF6-80C2B1F, and the Rolls-Royce RB211-524G/H. According to technical documentation from Aircraft Commerce , these modern turbofans produced between 56,500 lbf (251 kN) and 63,300 lbf (282 kN) of static thrust depending on the sub-variant, delivering vastly superior fuel efficiency and payload range over early-generation 747 powerplants.

This customer-first engineering philosophy was not born overnight. Instead, it was the natural culmination of two decades of operational feedback, market evolution, and rapid fleet expansion across earlier iterations of the Queen of the Skies. When Boeing initially launched the 747 program in the late 1960s, a single-engine approach was necessary to get the massive airframe off the ground efficiently. However, as international routes expanded and global competition intensified, airlines made it clear that airframe versatility was just as vital as raw lift capacity.

When the original Boeing 747-100 entered commercial service in 1970, it was powered exclusively by Pratt & Whitney’s JT9D turbofans. However, as international airlines expanded their long-haul networks throughout the 1970s, carriers operating mixed fleets demanded engine options that matched their existing equipment. As recorded by Airliner World , Boeing responded during the development of the 747-200 and 747-300 by integrating General Electric's CF6 and Rolls-Royce's RB211, establishing the multi-engine paradigm that would later define the 747-400 program.

The economic incentive for airlines to maintain engine commonality across their fleets was overwhelming. An airline already flying CF6-powered Douglas DC-10s or RB211-powered Lockheed L-1011 TriStars could seamlessly integrate the 747-400 without investing millions of dollars in duplicate ground support tooling, specialized mechanic training, or spare engine inventory. Historical fleet analysis from Boeing-747.com notes that this operational flexibility allowed flagship carriers like British Airways , Lufthansa , and Cathay Pacific to optimize their long-haul maintenance budgets while scaling up international routes.

In addition to the financial benefits of fleet commonality, the three powerplants offered on the 747-400 formed two different approaches to jet engine engineering. General Electric and Pratt & Whitney favored a traditional dual-spool design that prioritized mechanical simplicity and established maintenance procedures, whereas Rolls-Royce pursued a complex triple-spool design engineered for higher thermal efficiency and rapid throttle response. Boeing allowed international carriers to select not only an engine supplier, but the exact internal mechanical philosophy that best aligned with their long-term operational and engineering strategies.

Moving to the internal engine design, the key differentiator between the engines is the two-spool versus three-spool design. The General Electric CF6-80C2 and Pratt & Whitney PW4056 used a classic two-spool configuration, where concentric shafts connect high-pressure and low-pressure turbine stages to their respective compressors and fan sections. As detailed in technical analysis from Aircraft Commerce , the two-shaft arrangement reduced the overall count of rotating bearings and internal seals, lowering initial overhaul complexity and offering a proven, highly reliable mechanical baseline for long-haul operators.

In contrast, Rolls-Royce equipped its RB211-524G/H with a unique triple-spool layout featuring three independent, concentric shafts rotating at different optimal speeds. According to information from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University , splitting the compressor into low, intermediate, and high-pressure sections allowed each stage to operate closer to its peak aerodynamic efficiency across varying altitudes and flight regimes. The three-shaft design yielded superior surge margin protection, faster engine acceleration during go-arounds, and reduced overall blade stress, though it needed more specific shop tooling and unique maintenance procedures during heavy C and D checks.

The existence of these contrasting mechanical designs gave airlines unprecedented flexibility in structuring their engineering departments. However, beyond thermodynamic efficiency and spool counts, offering three competing powerplants provided airlines with a critical operational safety net against catastrophic fleet groundings.

In commercial aviation, an Airworthiness Directive (AD) or unforeseen safety issue targeting a specific engine family can instantly paralyze an airline’s widebody operations. If an airframe is built around a single exclusive powerplant, any fleet-wide grounding directive immediately halts long-haul schedules and costs carriers millions of dollars per day in lost revenue. As highlighted in Simple Flying coverage , the multi-engine compatibility of the 747-400 provided major international airlines with an invaluable operational insurance policy, allowing carriers to hedge their long-term fleet risk across multiple engine manufacturers.
body_zh: 最全能？为什么波音让标志性的 747-400 兼容 3 种不同的动力装置
航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。

20 世纪 80 年代末，当波音公司准备推出其标志性大型喷气式飞机的最终版本时，它为航空公司客户提供了非凡的运营控制水平。大多数其他飞机只为全球航空公司提供一两个发动机制造商的选择，但波音公司设计的 747-400 能够无缝地容纳来自三个竞争航空航天巨头的三种完全不同的动力装置：通用电气、普惠公司和劳斯莱斯。三选项兼容性允许航空公司订购相同的四引擎宽体客机，并根据其现有的维护生态系统、飞行员类型评级和区域制造商忠诚度进行定制。
将三种完全不同的发动机集成到一个机翼上是一项巨大的结构和财务任务。每个发动机型号都需要定制的机舱设计、驾驶舱指示逻辑和昂贵的适航认证飞行测试。为什么波音愿意承担为单一飞机项目认证三种竞争发动机所需的惊人开发成本？
在 747-400 上提供三种不同的发动机选项的最大动机是通过消除购买障碍来确保商业市场的主导地位。 20 世纪 80 年代末，主要长途航空公司对基于现有检修基础设施和当地供应链的特定发动机制造商有着强烈的忠诚度。正如《Simple Flying》所强调的那样，确保通用电气、普惠公司和劳斯莱斯公司都可以在机身上使用，这意味着对发动机的偏好永远不会成为航空公司寻求竞争性宽体设计的原因。
波音公司通过普拉特·惠特尼 PW4056、通用电气 CF6-80C2B1F 和劳斯莱斯 RB211-524G/H 认证了 747-400。根据 Aircraft Commerce 的技术文件，这些现代涡轮风扇发动机可产生 56,500 磅力（251 kN）至 63,300 磅力（282 kN）的静态推力，具体取决于子型号，与早期的 747 发动机相比，提供了极其优越的燃油效率和有效载荷范围。
这种客户至上的工程理念并非一朝一夕诞生的。相反，这是二十年来运营反馈、市场演变以及天空女王早期版本机队快速扩张的自然结果。当波音公司在 20 世纪 60 年代末首次启动 747 计划时，需要采用单引擎方法才能使庞大的机身高效地起飞。然而，随着国际航线的扩大和全球竞争的加剧，航空公司明确表示机身的多功能性与原始升力能力同样重要。

当最初的波音 747-100 于 1970 年进入商业服务时，它完全由普惠公司的 JT9D 涡轮风扇发动机提供动力。然而，随着国际航空公司在 20 世纪 70 年代扩展其长途网络，运营混合机队的航空公司需要与其现有设备相匹配的发动机选项。据《航空世界》报道，波音在 747-200 和 747-300 的开发过程中做出了回应，整合了通用电气的 CF6 和劳斯莱斯的 RB211，建立了多引擎范例，该范例后来定义了 747-400 计划。

航空公司在其机队中保持发动机通用性的经济动机是巨大的。已经飞行 CF6 动力的道格拉斯 DC-10 或 RB211 动力的洛克希德 L-1011 TriStar 的航空公司可以无缝集成 747-400，而无需投资数百万美元购买重复的地面支持工具、专门的机械培训或备用发动机库存。波音 747.com 的历史机队分析表明，这种运营灵活性使英国航空、汉莎航空和国泰航空等旗舰航空公司能够优化其长途维护预算，同时扩大国际航线。
除了机队通用性带来的经济效益之外，747-400 提供的三种动力装置形成了两种不同的喷气发动机工程方法。通用电气和普惠公司青睐传统的双阀芯设计，优先考虑机械简单性和建立维护程序，而劳斯莱斯则追求复杂的三阀芯设计，旨在提高热效率和快速油门响应。波音公司不仅允许国际航空公司选择发动机供应商，还可以选择最符合其长期运营和工​​程战略的内部机械理念。
转向内部发动机设计，发动机之间的主要区别在于两转子和三转子设计。通用电气 CF6-80C2 和普惠 PW4056 使用经典的双轴配置，其中同心轴将高压和低压涡轮级连接到各自的压缩机和风扇部分。正如 Aircraft Commerce 的技术分析中详细介绍的那样，两轴布置减少了旋转轴承和内部密封件的总数，降低了初始检修的复杂性，并为长途运营商提供了经过验证的、高度可靠的机械基准。
相比之下，劳斯莱斯为​​其 RB211-524G/H 配备了独特的三线轴布局，具有三个以不同最佳速度旋转的独立同心轴。根据安柏里德航空大学的信息，将压气机分为低压、中压和高压部分，使每一级在不同的高度和飞行状态下都能更接近其峰值空气动力效率。三轴设计产生了卓越的喘振裕度保护，复飞期间更快的发动机加速，并降低了整体叶片应力，尽管在繁重的 C 和 D 检查期间需要更具体的车间工具和独特的维护程序。
这些对比鲜明的机械设计的存在为航空公司在构建工程部门方面提供了前所未有的灵活性。然而，除了热力学效率和线轴数量之外，提供三种竞争动力装置还为航空公司提供了防止灾难性机队停飞的关键运营安全网。

在商业航空中，针对特定发动机系列的适航指令 (AD) 或不可预见的安全问题可能会立即导致航空公司的宽体机运营陷入瘫痪。如果机身是围绕单一专用动力装置建造的，任何机队范围内的停飞指令都会立即停止长途航班，并使航空公司每天损失数百万美元的收入。正如 Simple Flying 报道中所强调的，747-400 的多引擎兼容性为主要国际航空公司提供了宝贵的运营保险政策，使航空公司能够对冲多个引擎制造商之间的长期机队风险。

Alaska Airlines will add another nonstop international route from its Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA) hub, offering a direct link to Guadalajara International Airport (GDL). The route will operate up to three times a week starting March 18 and will be served by the airline's Boeing 737-800 aircraft.

Demand for travel to the Mexican state of Jalisco remains popular for West Coast travelers, and Alaska will become the third carrier serving the city pair. Volaris and Aeromexico already operate nonstop flights to Guadalajara from Seattle.

Alaska Airlines Adds Nonstop Flights To Guadalajara From March

In mid-March, oneworld alliance partner Alaska will serve Seattle to Guadalajara for the first time. The airline has never operated to Guadalajara from Seattle before, and will join the incumbent Volaris, which has been operating the route since 2016 .

Aeromexico also began serving the route in 2025, and will provide stiff competition for Alaska Airlines' three-weekly service. With Alaska joining the group of airlines on the city pair, this will mark the first time three airlines have all operated the route concurrently.

Guadalajara International Airport is the third busiest airport in Mexico, and will become Alaska Airlines' third route to the airport. The airline currently maintains year-round services from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), and seasonal services from Norman Y. Mineta San Jose International Airport (SJC). The new Seattle service is expected to operate year-round. Full list of these routes with competition below
Three Weekly Flights From Seattle To Guadalajara From March 18
Tickets are already on sale, with the airline's website showing passengers able to book their next trip from Seattle to Guadalajara with round-trip fares in its Saver fare for $615 return.

Outbound flights from Seattle are scheduled to depart late evening, with a five-and-a-half-hour flight time. The nonstop flight arrives in the early morning at Guadalajara the next day. The return flight departs at noon, with a late afternoon arrival back in Seattle. Full schedule as below

For travelers, these flight times will enable a full day in Seattle before departing for Mexico , and a modest noon departure time on the return flight avoids the early morning wake-up before heading to the airport.

title_en: NTSB finds evidence of in-flight breakup before Florida Learjet crash
title_zh: NTSB 发现佛罗里达里尔喷气式飞机坠毁前机上解体的证据
summary: National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) investigators said they have found evidence that a Learjet 60 shed some components… The post NTSB finds evidence of in-flight breakup before Florida Learjet crash appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 调查人员表示，他们已发现证据表明里尔 60 飞机脱落了一些部件…… NTSB 发现 ev
body_en: National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) investigators said they have found evidence that a Learjet 60 shed some components before it crashed near West Palm Beach, Florida, killing all nine people aboard on November 1, 2026.
Asked at a November 2 media briefing whether the horizontal stabilizer had separated from the Learjet, NTSB Board Member Tom Chapman did not confirm which components might have come off.
“We do have some evidence that there was some breakup of the aircraft before impact,” Chapman said. “We’re still seeking to determine that.”

The NTSB said the aircraft was operated by Aurora Aviation, doing business as Upper Jets, on a Part 135 charter flight. It departed Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS) at 09:37 local time for North Eleuthera Airport (ELH) in the Bahamas, carrying two pilots and seven passengers.
The Learjet crashed at approximately 12:51 local time. One man in a vehicle on the ground suffered a leg injury, Chapman said.

Chapman and investigator-in-charge Timothy Monville outlined the crew’s communications with Miami Air Route Traffic Control Center (ARTCC) before the crash, saying investigators would examine the weather and ATC communications.

At approximately 12:47 local time, a female pilot reported light clear ice that was manageable, along with moderate turbulence. The aircraft was at 35,000 feet, and the crew reported altitude deviations of about 700 feet and an outside air temperature of -47 degrees Celsius.
Soon afterward, the crew reported encountering precipitation and requested a climb to 37,000 feet. Air traffic control approved the request.

Less than 30 seconds later, the female pilot reported that the aircraft was descending, followed by a mayday call and reported descent rates reaching 20,000 feet per minute. Investigators have not yet determined whether she or the other pilot was flying the aircraft.

The NTSB has not confirmed whether the Learjet flew through an active thunderstorm, but Chapman said investigators will review the conditions along the flight’s route as they work to establish what preceded the loss of control.

A team of about 20 NTSB investigators began arriving Sunday night, he said, with additional agency personnel arriving Monday. The investigation will include a review of the aircraft’s history and whether similar accidents have involved other Learjet 60s.

Recovery work faces significant challenges. The aircraft struck the ground at high speed in a nearly vertical descent, and water filling the impact crater is hampering access to the wreckage, Chapman said.
Chapman said the aircraft was listed as carrying a cockpit voice recorder, which investigators had not yet recovered.
Although the debris field identified so far is small, the evidence of a possible in-flight breakup means investigators may need to search farther from the main impact site.
Officials are also working to restore access for about 600 nearby residents so they can return to their homes as soon as possible, Chapman said.

body_zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 调查人员表示，他们发现的证据表明，一架里尔 60 型飞机于 2026 年 11 月 1 日在佛罗里达州西棕榈滩附近坠毁，导致机上 9 人全部遇难，之前该飞机脱落了一些部件。
在 11 月 2 日的媒体吹风会上被问及水平稳定器是否与里尔喷气机分离时，NTSB 董事会成员汤姆·查普曼 (Tom Chapman) 没有证实哪些部件可能脱落。
查普曼说：“我们确实有一些证据表明飞机在撞击之前发生了一些破裂。” “我们仍在寻求确定这一点。”
NTSB 表示，这架飞机由 Aurora Aviation 运营，其业务名称为 Upper Jets，属于第 135 部包机航班。这架飞机于当地时间 09:37 从奥斯汀-伯格斯特罗姆国际机场 (AUS) 出发，飞往巴哈马的北伊柳塞拉机场 (ELH)，机上载有两名飞行员和七名乘客。
里尔喷气式飞机于当地时间12点51分左右坠毁。查普曼说，地面上一辆车内的一名男子腿部受伤。
查普曼和负责调查的蒂莫西·蒙维尔概述了坠机前机组人员与迈阿密航线交通控制中心（ARTCC）的通信情况，并表示调查人员将检查天气和空中交通管制通信。
当地时间 12 点 47 分左右，一名女飞行员报告称，有轻微透明的冰，可以控制，并伴有中度湍流。飞机飞行高度为 35,000 英尺，机组人员报告高度偏差约为 700 英尺，外部气温为 -47 摄氏度。
不久之后，机组人员报告遇到降雨，并要求爬升至 37,000 英尺的高度。空中交通管制批准了这一请求。
不到 30 秒后，女飞行员报告飞机正在下降，随后发出求救信号，报告下降速度达到每分钟 20,000 英尺。调查人员尚未确定驾驶这架飞机的是她还是另一名飞行员。
美国国家运输安全委员会尚未证实这架里尔喷气式飞机是否飞越了活跃的雷暴天气，但查普曼表示，调查人员将审查该航班沿途的情况，并努力确定失控之前的情况。
他说，由大约 20 名 NTSB 调查人员组成的团队于周日晚上开始抵达，其他机构人员将于周一抵达。调查将包括回顾该飞机的历史以及类似事故是否涉及其他里尔 60 飞机。
恢复工作面临重大挑战。查普曼说，飞机以几乎垂直的下降速度高速撞击地面，撞击坑中充满了水，阻碍了对残骸的接近。
查普曼说，这架飞机被列为携带驾驶舱录音机，但调查人员尚未找到。
尽管迄今为止发现的碎片场很小，但可能在飞行中解体的证据意味着调查人员可能需要在距离主要撞击地点更远的地方进行搜索。
查普曼说，官员们还在努力为附近约 600 名居民恢复通行，以便他们能够尽快返回家园。

title_en: 5 Seaplane Destinations Where Cessna Caravan Amphibians Fly Passengers
title_zh: 塞斯纳大篷车两栖飞机载客的 5 个水上飞机目的地
summary: Not all runways are on land, and some of the destinations you can fly to with amphibious Cessna Caravans are truly special.
summary_zh: 并非所有跑道都在陆地上，您可以乘坐两栖塞斯纳大篷车飞往的一些目的地确实很特别。
body_en: Airline and Airport Management Graduate, Student Commercial Pilot and Commercial Aviation Writer.

The Cessna Caravan amphibian is easily one of the most versatile utility airframes in modern aviation. It combines a high-wing turboprop design with massive Wipline floats equipped with retractable wheels, allowing the aircraft to operate out of traditional airport runways and open bodies of water with equal ease. Powered by a reliable Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6A engine, the Grand Caravan delivers an operational cruise speed of roughly 160 knots (184 mph / 296 km/h) while providing a quiet, air-conditioned cabin for up to nine passengers.

For island archipelagos, coastal resort towns, and crowded metropolitan waterways, amphibious aircraft open up direct access where building traditional concrete runways is geographically or environmentally impossible. From remote island docks in the Caribbean to historic saltwater creeks in the Middle East, seaplane operators leverage the Caravan’s dual-land-and-water capability to bypass congested terminal gates. Here are five iconic destinations where passengers can experience the Cessna Caravan amphibian in scheduled and charter service today.
Providing essential connections for remote island communities

With over 700 islands and cays scattered across shallow turquoise waters, the Bahamian archipelago is an ideal operational environment for amphibious aviation. Major hubs like Nassau and Freeport boast long asphalt runways, but only a fraction of the outer islands feature paved airstrips capable of handling conventional regional aircraft. As per Tropic Ocean Airways , the Fort Lauderdale-based operator relies on its fleet of Cessna Grand Caravan EX amphibians to link South Florida directly with dockside landings across the Abacos, Harbour Island, and Bimini.

The flexibility of an amphibious floatplane completely changes how passengers access remote island communities. Landing directly alongside private marina docks, the Caravan takes away the need for lengthy ground transfers or secondary water taxi rides after landing at a regional airport. According to operational details highlighted by Textron Aviation , the Caravan’s short-field water performance allows it to operate out of tight cays and still carry a full load of baggage, sports gear, and passengers in air-conditioned comfort.

Safety regulations also play a key role in how these island routes are flown. Federal regulations permit single-pilot operations for aircraft of this size, but Tropic Ocean Airways enforces a strict internal policy requiring two fully qualified pilots on every flight deck, so that there is an added layer of redundancy when navigating variable coastal weather and marine traffic across the Caribbean.

In the United Arab Emirates (UAE), amphibious aviation combines luxury tourism with a deep historical nod to early commercial flight routes. Operating out of Dubai Creek, local operator Seawings flies nine-seat Cessna Caravan amphibians from the very waters where Imperial Airways Short Empire flying boats touched down during transatlantic and regional mail runs in the 1930s. According to reporting from Gulf News , the operator established daily scheduled water links connecting Ajman’s Al Zora Marina directly to Dubai Creek, alongside scenic aerial excursions over Abu Dhabi.

The unique geography of the UAE's coastline makes the Caravan amphibian an ideal platform for city sightseeing and inter-emirate transit. A typical 45-minute flight takes off from the saltwater channels of the creek, climbing smoothly to give passengers sweeping aerial views over iconic landmarks like the Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and the towering 2,717 feet (828 meters) structure of the Burj Khalifa, sights that are on the bucket list of many around the world.

Analysis from the Royal Aeronautical Society highlights how the Caravan’s large, panoramic cabin windows and high-wing layout provide unobstructed views for all nine passengers. Through the use of water runways along the Persian Gulf, operators can deliver executive tours and transfer flights easily, not needing to find runway slots at congested international hubs like Dubai International Airport (DXB).
Emergency squawks, holds, NOTAMs — live signals, no signup.
When traffic gets too heavy, take to the skies

During the peak summer season, the congested highways linking New York City to Long Island’s East End turn a standard drive into a grueling multi-hour journey. The best way to skip gridlocked road traffic is using amphibious Cessna Grand Caravan EX aircraft, which operators use to offer rapid point-to-point transfers from Manhattan to the Hamptons. As detailed by Business Jet Traveler , seasonal flights departing from East River seaplane bases like New York Skyports (NYS) can drop off passengers directly onto the waters of East Hampton or Shelter Sound in roughly 35 minutes.

The amphibious capability of the Grand Caravan EX is the critical enabler for this urban-to-coastal corridor. The aircraft can take off from the paved runways of regional airports around New York, splash down directly in the coastal bays of the Hamptons, or land on suburban airstrips depending on weather conditions and passenger preferences.
Heliport constrained with higher noise footprint

The incredible operational flexibility allows travelers to board a flight within sight of Midtown Manhattan skyscrapers and step onto a wooden dock in the Hamptons before a car could even clear city limits. Furthermore, the quiet PT6A turboprop engine helps operators maintain strict noise-abatement compliance when flying over sensitive coastal communities.
Connecting the islands with the large economic centers

In the American Northeast, connecting urban business centers with historic offshore islands is tough, mainly because of major geographical challenges. Traditionally, getting from downtown Boston to island retreats like Nantucket or Martha's Vineyard meant navigating city traffic out to Logan International Airport (BOS), or driving hours south to Cape Cod to catch a multi-hour passenger ferry. Operators like Tailwind Air pioneered skipping this congestion by utilizing amphibious Cessna Caravans departing directly from Boston Harbor, as detailed in Simple Flying coverage.

The key benefit of flying an amphibious turboprop in New England is that water-to-water and water-to-runway flexibility becomes possible. Departing from a water dock in Boston Harbor, a Cessna Caravan amphibian climbs out over Massachusetts Bay, cruising at typical altitudes of 5,000 feet to 8,000 feet (1,524 meters to 2,438 meters) before touching down at Nantucket Memorial Airport (ACK) or on local harbor waters in under 45 minutes.
body_zh: 航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。

塞斯纳大篷车两栖飞机无疑是现代航空中用途最广泛的通用机身之一。它结合了高翼涡轮螺旋桨飞机设计和配备可伸缩轮子的大型 Wipline 浮标，使飞机能够在传统机场跑道和开放水域中同样轻松地运行。 Grand Caravan 由可靠的 Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6A 发动机提供动力，可提供约 160 节（184 英里/小时/296 公里/小时）的运行巡航速度，同时提供安静的空调客舱，最多可容纳 9 名乘客。
对于岛屿群岛、沿海度假城镇和拥挤的大都市水道，水陆两用飞机开辟了直接通道，这些地方在地理或环境上无法建造传统的混凝土跑道。从加勒比海的偏远岛屿码头到中东历史悠久的咸水小溪，水上飞机运营商利用大篷车的水陆双能力绕过拥挤的码头大门。今天，乘客可以在以下五个标志性目的地体验塞斯纳大篷车两栖飞机的定期和包机服务。
为偏远岛屿社区提供必要的联系

巴哈马群岛拥有 700 多个岛屿和珊瑚礁，散布在碧绿的浅海中，是两栖航空的理想作战环境。拿骚和自由港等主要枢纽拥有长长的沥青跑道，但只有一小部分外岛拥有能够起降传统支线飞机的铺设跑道。根据 Tropic Ocean Airways 的说法，这家总部位于劳德代尔堡的运营商依靠其 Cessna Grand Caravan EX 两栖飞机机队将南佛罗里达州与阿巴科斯岛、哈勃岛和比米尼岛的码头着陆点直接连接起来。
水陆两用水上飞机的灵活性彻底改变了乘客前往偏远岛屿社区的方式。大篷车直接降落在私人码头旁边，无需在地区机场降落后进行漫长的地面交通或二次乘坐水上出租车。根据德事隆航空强调的运营细节，大篷车的短场水上性能使其能够在狭窄的珊瑚礁外运行，并且仍然可以在舒适的空调环境中运载满载行李、运动装备和乘客。
安全法规在这些岛屿航线的飞行方式中也发挥着关键作用。联邦法规允许单飞行员操作这种尺寸的飞机，但热带海洋航空公司执行严格的内部政策，要求每个飞行甲板上有两名完全合格的飞行员，以便在加勒比海多变的沿海天气和海上交通中航行时增加一层冗余。

在阿拉伯联合酋长国 (UAE)，水陆两用航空将豪华旅游与对早期商业航线的深刻历史致敬结合在一起。当地运营商 Seawings 在迪拜河 (Dubai Creek) 运营，从 1930 年代跨大西洋和区域邮件运输期间帝国航空短帝国 (Imperial Airways Short Empire) 水上飞机降落的水域起飞九座塞斯纳大篷车 (Cessna Caravan) 两栖飞机。据《海湾新闻》报道，运营商建立了每日定期水上线路，将阿吉曼的阿尔佐拉码头直接连接到迪拜河，同时还提供阿布扎比上空风景优美的空中游览。
阿联酋海岸线独特的地理位置使 Caravan 两栖车成为城市观光和酋长国间交通的理想平台。典型的飞行时间为 45 分钟，从海湾的咸水道起飞，平稳爬升，乘客可以鸟瞰朱美拉棕榈岛、迪拜码头和 2,717 英尺（828 米）高的哈利法塔等标志性地标建筑，这些都是世界各地许多人的愿望清单上的景点。
英国皇家航空学会的分析强调了大篷车的大型全景客舱窗户和高翼布局如何为所有九名乘客提供一览无余的视野。通过使用波斯湾沿岸的水上跑道，运营商可以轻松提供商务旅行和转机航班，而无需在迪拜国际机场 (DXB) 等拥挤的国际枢纽寻找跑道。
紧急呼叫、等待、航行通告 — 实时信号，无需注册。
当交通堵塞时，飞上天空
在夏季高峰期，连接纽约市和长岛东区的高速公路拥堵，标准车程变成了令人疲惫不堪的数小时旅程。避免道路拥堵的最佳方法是使用两栖塞斯纳大篷车 EX 飞机，运营商使用该飞机提供从曼哈顿到汉普顿的快速点对点接送服务。据 Business Jet Traveler 详细介绍，从纽约 Skyports (NYS) 等东河水上飞机基地出发的季节性航班可在大约 35 分钟内将乘客直接送至东汉普顿或谢尔特桑德水域。
Grand Caravan EX 的两栖能力是这条城市到沿海走廊的关键推动者。这些飞机可以从纽约周边地区机场的铺好的跑道起飞，直接降落在汉普顿的沿海海湾，或者根据天气条件和乘客的喜好降落在郊区的简易机场上。
直升机场受到较高噪音足迹的限制
令人难以置信的操作灵活性使旅客能够在曼哈顿中城摩天大楼的视野范围内登机，并在汽车超越城市界限之前登上汉普顿的木制码头。此外，安静的 PT6A 涡轮螺旋桨发动机可帮助运营商在飞越敏感的沿海社区时保持严格的降噪合规性。
连接岛屿与大型经济中心
在美国东北部，连接城市商业中心与历史悠久的近海岛屿非常困难，主要是因为面临重大的地理挑战。传统上，从波士顿市中心前往楠塔基特岛或玛莎葡萄园岛等岛屿度假胜地意味着乘坐城市交通前往洛根国际机场 (BOS)，或者驱车数小时向南前往科德角搭乘多小时的客运渡轮。 Tailwind Air 等运营商率先利用直接从波士顿港出发的两栖塞斯纳大篷车来避免拥堵，如 Simple Flying 报道中所述。
在新英格兰驾驶两栖涡轮螺旋桨飞机的主要好处是水对水和水对跑道的灵活性成为可能。塞斯纳大篷车两栖动物从波士顿港的水码头出发，爬出马萨诸塞湾，在 5,000 英尺至 8,000 英尺（1,524 米至 2,438 米）的典型海拔高度巡航，然后在 45 分钟内降落在楠塔基特纪念机场 (ACK) 或当地港口水域。

title_en: Buy Choice Privileges Points With 40% Bonus (0.74 Cents Each): Worth It?
title_zh: 购买带有 40% 奖励的选择特权积分（每个 0.74 美分）：值得吗？
summary: Choice Privileges is selling points with up to a 40% bonus through November 26, which works out to as little as 0.74 cents each. Here's whether it's worth buying.
