body_en: Choice Privileges is currently offering a promotion on purchased points , offering up to a 40% bonus, which is an opportunity to buy points for as little as 0.74 cents each. While this isn’t among the best promotions we’ve seen from the program, it’s still better than no bonus, and there are many situations where you could come out ahead.

Let’s take a look at everything you need to know about this deal, and talk about under what circumstances it makes sense to buy Choice Privileges points. I generally recommend buying points only if you have a short term use in mind, and are sure the math checks out.
Link: Buy Choice Privileges points with a bonus
Promotion on purchased Choice Privileges points

Between 12AM EDT on November 2 and 11:59PM EDT on November 26, 2026, Choice Privileges is offering a sale on purchased points . The accounts I manage show a bonus of up to 40%, which is structured as follows
Different accounts may very well show different offers, so you’ll want to log into your Choice Privileges account to see what you’re eligible for.
How much does it cost to buy Choice Privileges points?

Choice Privileges’ pricing when buying points isn’t linear, and you get a lower cost the more points you purchase, not even factoring in any promotional bonuses or discounts. Before factoring in any bonuses or discounts, the cost to purchase points ranges from 1.28 cents per point (if buying just 1,000 points) to 1.03 cents per point (if buying 180,000 points), and that’s inclusive of taxes and fees.
If you maxed out this promotion, you could purchase a total of 252,000 points (180,000 base points, plus 72,000 bonus points) for $1,854, which is a rate of 0.74 cents per Choice Privileges point.
Note that purchased points will post within 24 hours of completing the transaction, and the points earned don’t count toward Choice Privileges elite status.
How many Choice Privileges points can you buy?
Choice Privileges lets you purchase up to 180,000 points per account per calendar year, not factoring in any bonus points.
How does this compare to other Choice Privileges buy points promos?

When Choice offers a promotion on purchased points, it’s typically either a 30-45% discount or a 35-50% bonus. So this 40% bonus is toward the bottom end of that range. Personally, I’d decide on whether to make a purchase more based on if I had an immediate use in mind, rather than the exact cost per point.
Below is a chart with some of the recent promotions we saw from Choice Privileges on buying points, before this one, with the highest bonus amounts offered.

Buy points offer Start date End date Cost per point Up to 40% off September 7, 2026 October 22, 2026 0.62 cents Up to 40% off July 21, 2026 August 28, 2026 0.62 cents Up to 45% off July 14, 2026 July 20, 2026 0.57 cents Up to 50% bonus May 18, 2026 May 24, 2026 0.69 cents Up to 35% bonus March 30, 2026 April 28, 2026 0.76 cents Up to 30% discount February 16, 2026 March 15, 2026 0.72 cents Up to 40% bonus January 12, 2026 January 27, 2026 0.74 cents Which credit card should you buy Choice Privileges points with?

Choice Privileges points purchases are processed by points.com, meaning they don’t generally count as a hotel purchase for the purposes of credit card spending. There is one exception — if you use a co-branded Choice Privileges credit card, then these purchases are rewarded in the same way as hotel spending.

Otherwise, I’d recommend using a card with which you’re trying to reach a minimum spending requirement , or a credit card that maximizes your return on everyday spending . When in doubt, review which credit cards are best for buying points and miles .

While it doesn’t get much attention in the miles & points world, Choice is a huge hotel group, with over 7,000 properties in 40 countries, representing roughly 570,000 hotel rooms. Choice hotel brands include (among others) Ascend, Cambria, Comfort Inn, Sleep Inn, Quality Inn, Clarion, Rodeway Inn, and more.

The catch is that Choice doesn’t have that many aspirational properties. In general there’s the most value outright purchasing points if you have a premium redemption in mind, given that this is the best way to get outsized value compared to the cost of a stay if paying cash.

title_en: Are Authorized Users Eligible For Credit Card Bonuses?
title_zh: 授权用户有资格获得信用卡奖金吗？
summary: If you're an authorized user on someone else's credit card, can you still apply as the primary cardmember and earn the welcome bonus? The answer is yes.
summary_zh: 如果您是其他人信用卡的授权用户，您仍然可以申请作为主卡会员并赚取欢迎奖金吗？答案是ye
body_en: Here’s a topic that seems to cause confusion among some people. If you’re an authorized user on someone else’s credit card, are you eligible for the bonus on that card if you apply outright? The answer is actually pretty straightforward, so let me explain…
Authorized users are eligible for credit card bonuses

Credit cards frequently offer huge upfront welcome offers , whereby you can earn a lot of bonus points for spending a certain amount within a limited timeframe. While there are different credit card application rules for each bank, there are generally restrictions whereby an existing cardmember can’t apply for a card they already have, while also receiving the bonus.

How does that work in the context of authorized users? If you’re the authorized user on someone else’s credit card, can you apply for the card as the primary cardmember and earn the bonus? The answer is universally yes — being an authorized user on someone else’s credit card doesn’t preclude you from applying for that card yourself, and earning the bonus.
When welcome bonus rules talk about existing cardmembers, they’re specifically talking about primary cardmembers, and not authorized users.

You don’t even need to cancel your authorized user card to be able to do this. For example, say you’re an authorized user on your spouse’s Chase Sapphire Preferred® Card ( learn more ), or Citi Strata Premier® Card ( learn more ), or Capital One Venture X Rewards Credit Card ( learn more ). You could remain an authorized user, and still apply outright and earn the welcome bonus on the card.
Should you be an authorized user or apply outright?

For those in relationships, it can sometimes be difficult to decide under which circumstances it makes sense to apply for a card outright, rather than being an authorized user on a spouse’s card (and vice versa). There are pros and cons to each.

The advantage of adding someone as an authorized user is that it minimizes annual fees, since many cards have lower (or no) annual fees for authorized users, compared to the primary cardmembers. Meanwhile the advantages of having both people in a relationship apply for a card outright is that many cards have big welcome bonuses, and on top of that some cards pay for themselves on an ongoing basis.

The Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® ( learn more ) is a card where I’d consider adding a spouse as an authorized user, as the card offers an Admirals Club membership for the primary cardmember, and you can add up to three authorized users for a total of $175, and they receive Admirals Club access as well (after that it’s $175 per authorized user)

The New IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card ( learn more ) is a card where I think it makes sense for a spouse to apply separately, given the strong perks; the card has a $150 annual fee, and offers an anniversary free night certificate , IHG One Rewards Gold status (Platinum with $15,000 in spend), a fourth night free on award redemptions, up to $50 in United credits annually , and more
For more on this topic, see my post on the best credit card strategy for families .

Many credit cards have amazing welcome bonuses, though you’re generally only eligible for them if you don’t already have that card. The good news is that across the board, being an authorized user on someone else’s card still makes you eligible to apply for that card outright and receive the bonus (assuming you’re otherwise eligible for the card).
Therefore this really comes down to deciding for each card whether the economics of applying outright make sense.

授权用户有资格获得信用卡奖金
信用卡经常提供巨额预付款迎新优惠，您可以在有限的时间内消费一定金额即可赚取大量奖励积分。虽然每家银行都有不同的信用卡申请规则，但通常存在一些限制，即现有持卡会员不能在获得奖金的同时申请他们已有的卡。
在授权用户的情况下它是如何工作的？如果您是别人信用卡的授权用户，您可以作为主卡会员申请该卡并赚取奖金吗？答案普遍是肯定的——成为别人信用卡的授权用户并不妨碍您自己申请该卡并赚取奖金。
当欢迎奖金规则谈到现有持卡会员时，他们特指主要持卡会员，而不是授权用户。
您甚至不需要取消您的授权用户卡即可执行此操作。例如，假设您是您配偶的 Chase Sapphire Preferred® 卡（了解更多信息）、Citi Strata Premier® 卡（了解更多信息）或 Capital One Venture X Rewards 信用卡（了解更多信息）的授权用户。您可以保留授权用户身份，并且仍然直接申请并赚取卡上的欢迎奖金。
您应该成为授权用户还是直接申请？
对于那些处于恋爱关系中的人来说，有时可能很难决定在什么情况下应该直接申请一张卡，而不是成为配偶卡的授权用户（反之亦然）。各有利弊。
将某人添加为授权用户的优点是可以最大限度地减少年费，因为与主卡会员相比，许多卡的授权用户年费较低（或没有）。与此同时，让恋爱关系中的双方直接申请一张卡的好处是，许多卡都有丰厚的欢迎奖金，而且最重要的是，有些卡可以持续为自己付费。
Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard®（了解更多）是一张我会考虑将配偶添加为授权用户的卡，因为该卡为主卡会员提供 Admirals Club 会员资格，您最多可以添加三位授权用户，总计 175 美元，他们也可以获得 Admirals Club 访问权限（之后每位授权用户为 175 美元）
新的 IHG One Rewards Premier 信用卡（了解更多）是一张我认为配偶单独申请的信用卡，因为它的福利非常好；该卡年费为 150 美元，并提供周年纪念免费住宿礼券、IHG One Rewards 金卡会员身份（消费满 15,000 美元即可获得白金卡）、奖励兑换时第四晚免费、每年最多 50 美元的美联航积分等
有关此主题的更多信息，请参阅我关于家庭最佳信用卡策略的文章。
许多信用卡都有惊人的欢迎奖金，但通常只有在您还没有该卡的情况下才有资格获得这些奖金。好消息是，从整体上来说，成为他人卡的授权用户仍然有资格直接申请该卡并获得奖金（假设您有资格获得该卡）。
因此，这实际上取决于决定每张卡直接申请的经济性是否有意义。

body_en: Emirates to bring Airbus A380 back to Brussels Airport on 10 March 2027 - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Brussels Airport (BRU) Emirates to bring Airbus A380 back to Brussels Airport on 10 March...
Emirates is planning to operate a one-off Airbus A380 flight to Brussels Airport on 10 March 2027, marking another visit by the airline’s double-deck aircraft to the Belgian airport.

According to aviation website Flightlevel.be , published on 30 October 2026, Emirates will deploy an A380 on its morning flight from Dubai to Brussels. The operation will be a one-off deployment rather than the introduction of a scheduled A380 service.

The visit will provide another opportunity to test Brussels Airport’s triple passenger boarding bridge at gate B33. The infrastructure was inaugurated in April 2018, when Emirates operated a special A380 flight to Brussels.

Aviation24.be was present during the inauguration and reported on the operation in April 2018 . As detailed in our coverage at the time, the aircraft involved was registered A6-EUG and carried a Real Madrid special livery. The test did not go entirely as planned: although the first passenger boarding bridge connected successfully to the lower deck, the other two bridges could not be used as intended. The upper-deck bridge could not reach the aircraft.
[Trip report + static visit] Emirates Airlines Airbus A380 at Brussels Airport

Brussels Airport had invested more than €52 million in new passenger boarding bridges for Pier B, with gates B31 and B33 equipped with triple-bridge infrastructure designed to accommodate the Airbus A380.

Emirates had previously brought an A380 to Brussels in September 2015, when the aircraft operated a special flight celebrating the first anniversary of its Dubai-Brussels route. Due to thunderstorms, an Emirates A380 made a diversion from Paris Charles de Gaulle on June 18th 2023.
The March 2027 operation will therefore be an important opportunity to demonstrate that the infrastructure can handle the world’s largest passenger aircraft as originally intended.

If the test is successful, it could potentially pave the way for more frequent A380 visits to Brussels, or even scheduled operations in the future. However, neither Emirates nor Brussels Airport has announced plans for a regular A380 service.

阿联酋航空计划于 2027 年 3 月 10 日运营一架一次性空客 A380 航班飞往布鲁塞尔机场，这标志着该航空公司的双层飞机再次访问比利时机场。
据航空网站 Flightlevel.be 于 2026 年 10 月 30 日发布的消息，阿联酋航空将在从迪拜飞往布鲁塞尔的早间航班上部署 A380。此次运营将是一次性部署，而不是引入定期的 A380 服务。
此次访问将为测试布鲁塞尔机场 B33 号登机口的三重旅客登机桥提供另一个机会。该基础设施于 2018 年 4 月启用，当时阿联酋航空运营了一架专门飞往布鲁塞尔的 A380 航班。
Aviation24.be 出席了就职典礼并报道了 2018 年 4 月的运营情况。正如我们当时的报道所详述的，涉事飞机注册为 A6-EUG，并带有皇家马德里的特殊涂装。测试并没有完全按计划进行：尽管第一座旅客登机桥成功连接到下层甲板，但其他两座登机桥却无法按预期使用。上层甲板的驾驶台无法到达飞机。
【行程报道+静态参观】阿联酋航空空客A380在布鲁塞尔机场
布鲁塞尔机场已投资超过 5200 万欧元为 B 号码头修建新的旅客登机桥，B31 和 B33 登机口配备了专为空客 A380 起降而设计的三桥基础设施。
阿联酋航空此前曾于 2015 年 9 月将一架 A380 飞往布鲁塞尔，当时该飞机执飞了一次特别航班，庆祝其迪拜-布鲁塞尔航线一周年。由于雷暴天气，阿联酋航空一架 A380 飞机于 2023 年 6 月 18 日从巴黎戴高乐机场改道。
因此，2027 年 3 月的运营将是一个重要机会，可以证明基础设施能够按照最初的预期承载世界上最大的客机。
如果测试成功，这可能为 A380 更频繁地访问布鲁塞尔甚至未来的预定运营铺平道路。然而，阿联酋航空和布鲁塞尔机场都没有宣布定期 A380 航班服务的计划。

body_en: Ryanair faces 1,043 criminal summonses in Belgium over alleged social fraud - Aviation24.be
Ryanair is facing renewed legal pressure in Belgium following an eight-year investigation into alleged social fraud and breaches of employment and social security legislation.

According to Belgian newspaper Le Soir , which reported on 28 October 2026 , authorities have prepared 1,043 criminal summonses relating to suspected irregularities in the employment of pilots, cabin crew members and other personnel. The investigation particularly concerns Ryanair’s operations around Brussels Airport and Brussels South Charleroi Airport.
The Belgian state reportedly expects to recover at least €5 million in unpaid social security contributions.

Justice Minister Annelies Verlinden confirmed during a parliamentary session on 21 October that the criminal summonses had been prepared, although they were still awaiting final validation by the relevant prosecutorial authorities.

The investigation, which began in 2018, examines Ryanair’s employment arrangements, social security contributions and the use of foreign employment structures. Authorities have been looking into whether the airline complied with Belgian labour and social security legislation when employing personnel based in Belgium.

The lengthy investigation has attracted criticism from trade unions. Didier Lebbe of the CNE union has expressed frustration over the delays, arguing that affected workers have been waiting years for the case to progress.
International judicial cooperation has also contributed to the delays, including requests for assistance from the United Kingdom.
Ryanair’s response to the latest developments was not available at the time of publication.

The case has not yet resulted in a conviction. However, if the proceedings go ahead, they could have significant implications for Ryanair’s employment practices in Belgium and potentially set an important precedent for the enforcement of labour and social security legislation in the aviation sector.

在对涉嫌社会欺诈以及违反就业和社会保障立法进行了八年的调查后，瑞安航空在比利时面临着新的法律压力。
据比利时《晚报》2026 年 10 月 28 日报道，当局已准备了 1,043 份刑事传票，涉及飞行员、机组人员和其他人员雇用方面涉嫌违规行为。此次调查特别涉及瑞安航空在布鲁塞尔机场和布鲁塞尔南沙勒罗瓦机场附近的运营。
据报道，比利时政府预计将收回至少 500 万欧元未缴纳的社会保障缴款。
司法部长 Annelies Verlinden 在 10 月 21 日的议会会议上证实，刑事传票已准备就绪，但仍在等待相关检察机关的最终确认。
该调查于 2018 年开始，审查瑞安航空的雇佣安排、社会保障缴款以及外国雇佣结构的使用。当局一直在调查该航空公司在雇用比利时员工时是否遵守比利时劳动和社会保障立法。
漫长的调查引起了工会的批评。 CNE 工会的迪迪埃·莱贝 (Didier Lebbe) 对延误表示失望，他认为受影响的工人多年来一直在等待案件取得进展。
国际司法合作也造成了延误，包括向英国提出援助请求。
截至本文发布时，瑞安航空尚未对最新进展做出回应。
此案尚未定罪。然而，如果诉讼继续进行，可能会对瑞安航空在比利时的雇佣实践产生重大影响，并可能为航空业劳动和社会保障立法的执行树立重要先例。

body_en: Boeing has won an order from Iceland-based lessor Icelease for up to three 767-300BCF cargo aircraft, with the conversion work set to take place in Singapore.

On November 2, 2026, Boeing issued a statement advising that an agreement with Icelease for a single 767-300BCF, with an option for two more, was signed at the Cargo Facts Symposium on October 22, 2026.

The US firm will convert the aircraft at ST Engineering’s airframe MRO facilities in Singapore. Induction of the first aircraft is scheduled for Q1 2027, with delivery of the converted aircraft expected in Q2 2027.

“This agreement with Boeing to convert up to three Boeing 767 aircraft marks an important milestone for both Icelease and its Dublin-based sister company IAT Leasing,” Sigthor Einarsson, Managing Partner, Icelease , said. “The history between Icelease and Boeing dates over 20 years and includes a multitude of new aircraft deliveries as well as cargo conversions.”

Einarsson added: “The Boeing 767-300BCF will join the growing managed cargo aircraft portfolio of IAT Leasing, which already includes seven Boeing 737-800BCF and other freighters leased to various customers.”

According to the planemaker, Icelease has a portfolio of around 40 narrow and wide body passenger and cargo aircraft, which are owned by four different equity partners and are leased to airlines around the world.

“Icelease is an important partner for our Boeing Converted Freighter programs, and this agreement underlines our continued collaboration to meet global cargo demand,” Lindsey Douglas, Vice President, Cabin, Modifications, Maintenance and Digital Services, said. “The 767-300BCF is a proven performer in the cargo industry, and we are confident it will continue to deliver value for many years to come.”

body_zh: 波音公司已赢得冰岛租赁商 Icelease 的一份最多三架 767-300BCF 货机的订单，改装工作将在新加坡进行。
2026 年 11 月 2 日，波音公司发表声明称，已于 2026 年 10 月 22 日在货运事实研讨会上与 Icelease 签署了购买一架 767-300BCF 的协议，并可选择购买另外两架 767-300BCF。
这家美国公司将在新科工程位于新加坡的机身 MRO 工厂对飞机进行改装。第一架飞机计划于 2027 年第一季度投入使用，改装后的飞机预计于 2027 年第二季度交付。
Icelease 管理合伙人 Sigthor Einarsson 表示：“与波音公司达成的这项改装最多三架波音 767 飞机的协议，对于 Icelease 及其位于都柏林的姊妹公司 IAT Leasing 来说都是一个重要的里程碑。” “Icelease 和波音之间的历史可以追溯到 20 多年，其中包括大量新飞机交付以及货物改装。”
Einarsson 补充道：“波音 767-300BCF 将加入 IAT Leasing 不断增长的托管货机组合，其中已包括向不同客户租赁的七架波音 737-800BCF 和其他货机。”
据该飞机制造商称，Icelease 拥有约 40 架窄体和宽体客机和货机，这些飞机由四个不同的股权合作伙伴拥有，并租赁给世界各地的航空公司。
“Icelease 是我们波音改装货机项目的重要合作伙伴，该协议强调了我们为满足全球货运需求而持续合作，”客舱、改装、维护和数字服务副总裁 Lindsey Douglas 表示。 “767-300BCF 是货运行业久经考验的表现者，我们相信它将在未来许多年继续创造价值。”
波音赢得 Icelease 最多三架 767-300BCF 订单后，新加坡的改装首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

A Wizz Air flight from London Luton to Sofia was diverted to Budapest, Hungary, on Monday, 2 November, after receiving a bomb threat while en route. Hungarian Air Force Gripen fighter jets were scrambled to escort the Airbus A321neo to a safe landing at Budapest Liszt Ferenc International Airport.

The aircraft was flying from London Luton Airport to Sofia, Bulgaria, when the threat was received. While flying over Bosnia and Herzegovina, the crew changed course and requested permission to land in Budapest.

According to Hungarian Defence Minister Romulusz Ruszin-Szendi, NATO’s air defence readiness service issued an ALPHA alert, prompting the Hungarian military to scramble Gripen fighters within minutes. The military aircraft escorted the passenger aircraft to Budapest, where it landed safely at approximately 12:08 local time.

Firefighters, police officers and counter-terrorism personnel were waiting for the aircraft on arrival. Following landing, the Airbus was directed to a designated parking position, where authorities began security inspections of the aircraft and its passengers.
Wizz Air confirmed the diversion, stating that the flight from London Luton to Sofia had been redirected to Budapest following a bomb threat received during the journey.

“ The aircraft was diverted and landed safely at Budapest Liszt Ferenc International Airport, in accordance with the relevant safety protocols and procedures. It subsequently moved to a designated position, where the competent authorities carried out the necessary security checks on the aircraft and passengers ,” the airline said.

The Hungarian Gripen fighters returned to their base at Kecskemét after the escort operation. Budapest Airport’s second runway was temporarily closed following the incident, with arriving and departing flights using the other runway while security measures were carried out.
Authorities have not yet disclosed further details about the nature of the bomb threat or whether any suspicious items were discovered during the inspections.

11 月 2 日星期一，维兹航空 (Wizz Air) 一架从伦敦卢顿飞往索非亚的航班在途中收到炸弹威胁，随后改道飞往匈牙利布达佩斯。匈牙利空军鹰狮战斗机紧急紧急升空，护送这架空客 A321neo 在布达佩斯李斯特·费伦茨国际机场安全着陆。
收到威胁时，这架飞机正在从伦敦卢顿机场飞往保加利亚索非亚。在飞越波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那时，机组人员改变航线并请求允许在布达佩斯降落。
匈牙利国防部长罗穆卢斯·鲁辛-森迪表示，北约防空战备部门发布了阿尔法警报，促使匈牙利军方在几分钟内出动“鹰狮”战斗机。军机护送客机飞往布达佩斯，于当地时间12时08分左右安全降落。
消防员、警察和反恐人员正在等待飞机抵达。着陆后，空客飞机被引导至指定的停车位置，当局开始对飞机及其乘客进行安全检查。
维兹航空证实了这一改道，并表示，从伦敦卢顿飞往索非亚的航班在旅途中收到炸弹威胁后已改飞布达佩斯。
该航空公司表示：“根据相关安全协议和程序，飞机改道并安全降落在布达佩斯李斯特·费伦茨国际机场。随后飞机转移到指定位置，主管当局在那里对飞机和乘客进行了必要的安全检查。”
护航行动结束后，匈牙利“鹰狮”战斗机返回凯奇凯梅特基地。事件发生后，布达佩斯机场的第二跑道暂时关闭，进出航班使用另一条跑道，同时采取安全措施。
当局尚未透露有关炸弹威胁的性质或检查期间是否发现任何可疑物品的更多细节。

Home Miscellaneous Accidents Nine killed as Bahamas-bound Learjet crashes in Florida

All nine people aboard a Learjet 60 registered N722BD died when it crashed in Palm Beach County, Florida, on Sunday, 1 November 2026, US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed. The aircraft was flying from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport to North Eleuthera in the Bahamas.

The jet came down near Military Trail and 10th Avenue North at approximately 12:50 local time, erupting into flames. Authorities closed the surrounding roads. Whether anyone on the ground was injured had not been confirmed in the latest reporting.

According to a CNN report, the crew reported icing and moderate turbulence before declaring an emergency during a rapid descent. These reports do not establish the cause. The National Transportation Safety Board will lead the investigation, supported by the FAA; the identities of those aboard have not yet been released.

美国交通部长肖恩·达菲证实，2026 年 11 月 1 日星期日，一架注册为 N722BD 的 Learjet 60 在佛罗里达州棕榈滩县坠毁，机上 9 人全部遇难。这架飞机当时从奥斯汀-博格斯多姆国际机场飞往巴哈马的北伊留塞拉。
当地时间12点50分左右，这架飞机在军事步道和第十大道北附近坠毁，并起火。当局关闭了周围的道路。最新报道尚未证实地面上是否有人受伤。
据美国有线电视新闻网报道，在快速下降过程中，机组人员报告了结冰和中度湍流，然后宣布进入紧急状态。这些报告没有确定原因。美国国家运输安全委员会将在美国联邦航空局的支持下领导调查；机上人员的身份尚未公布。
